sentences.en: We think about the discovery of a lost masterpiece as a once-in-a-lifetime kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 我们通常认为发现一件失传的杰作是千载难逢的事情。

sentences.en: I was writing about one such discovery, the first Rembrandt to be found in 42 years.
sentences.zh: 我当时正在撰写关于这样一项发现的报道，这是42年来首次发现的伦勃朗画作。

sentences.en: Now, in the world of fine art, Dutch masters are pretty much the pinnacle.
sentences.zh: 在艺术界，荷兰大师的作品几乎是巅峰之作。

sentences.en: In the 1600s, the Dutch revolutionized art, pulling it away from the religious.
sentences.zh: 17世纪，荷兰人彻底改变了艺术，使其脱离了宗教题材。

sentences.en: They painted flowers, street scenes.
sentences.zh: 他们画花卉，画街景。

sentences.en: They painted themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们画自己。

sentences.en: Probably the greatest of them was Rembrandt van Rijn.
sentences.zh: 其中最伟大的可能就是伦勃朗·范·莱因。

sentences.en: So this newly discovered masterpiece, it was a huge deal.
sentences.zh: 所以，这件新发现的杰作意义重大。

sentences.en: And the man who found it was a young art dealer with an amazing story.
sentences.zh: 而发现它的人是一位有着传奇经历的年轻艺术品商。

sentences.en: But as I was doing the reporting on it, I started to hear rumors.
sentences.zh: 但在我进行相关报道时，我开始听到一些传闻。

sentences.en: Apparently, a second
sentences.zh: 据说，第二幅

sentences.en: Rembrandt had been found.
sentences.zh: 伦勃朗画作被发现了。

sentences.en: And by the same guy.
sentences.zh: 而且还是同一个人发现的。

sentences.en: I'm Russell Shorto.
sentences.zh: 我是拉塞尔·肖托。

sentences.zh: 我是《纽约

sentences.en: I wrote a story about these Rembrandt paintings and the feud behind them.
sentences.zh: 我写了一篇关于这些伦勃朗画作及其背后纷争的故事。

sentences.en: It's also a story about family and the burden of legacy.
sentences.zh: 这同时也是一个关于家庭和传承重担的故事。

sentences.en: The man who discovered these paintings is Jan Six.
sentences.zh: 发现这些画作的人是扬·西克斯。

sentences.en: Jan is about as close to art world royalty as it comes.
sentences.zh: 扬在艺术界几乎就是皇室般的存在。

sentences.en: His family has roots in Amsterdam dating practically to its founding.
sentences.zh: 他的家族在阿姆斯特丹的根基几乎可以追溯到这座城市的建立。

sentences.en: He's actually Jan Six the eleventh.
sentences.zh: 他实际上是第十一代扬·西克斯。

sentences.en: And the first Jan Six had his portrait painted by
sentences.zh: 而第一代扬·西克斯曾请

sentences.en: Rembrandt.
sentences.zh: 伦勃朗为他画过肖像。

sentences.en: Now, most of us, when it comes to goals in life, we might think of landing a big job, having a house and a family.
sentences.zh: 大多数人在谈到人生目标时，可能会想到找一份好工作、拥有房子和家庭。

sentences.en: Jan's obsession was to find a Rembrandt.
sentences.zh: 而扬的执念是找到一幅伦勃朗的画。

sentences.en: One thing I realized while writing this piece is just how much work goes into identifying an old master painting.
sentences.zh: 在写这篇文章时，我意识到鉴定一幅古典大师画作需要付出多少心血。

sentences.en: There are all sorts of forensic examinations.
sentences.zh: 这涉及各种各样的法医鉴定。

sentences.en: You can take the painting right down to the canvas.
sentences.zh: 你可以把画作一直分析到画布层面。

sentences.en: You can use x-rays, infrared imagery, paint samples are analyzed, individual brush strokes, pigments.
sentences.zh: 你可以使用X光、红外成像，分析颜料样本、单个笔触和色素。

sentences.en: But no matter how high-tech the process, in the end, there's no such thing as absolute certainty.
sentences.zh: 但无论过程多么高科技，最终，世界上不存在绝对的确定性。

sentences.en: A newly discovered painting's identity is still a matter of interpretation.
sentences.zh: 一幅新发现画作的身份仍然是一个解读的问题。

sentences.en: It comes down to human conviction.
sentences.zh: 归根结底取决于人的信念。

sentences.en: And we're all perfect.
sentences.zh: 我们都是完美的。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: So here's my story.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的故事。

sentences.en: The discovery that upended Jan Six's life occurred one day in November 2016.
sentences.zh: 彻底改变扬·西克斯生活的发现发生在2016年11月的一天。

sentences.en: Six is a 40-year-old Dutch art dealer based in Amsterdam who attracted worldwide attention last year with the news that he had
sentences.zh: 西克斯是一位40岁的荷兰艺术品商，常驻阿姆斯特丹。去年，他宣布

sentences.en: unearthed a previously unknown painting by Rembrandt, the most revered of Dutch masters.
sentences.zh: 发掘出一幅此前未知的伦勃朗画作，引起了全世界的关注，伦勃朗是最受推崇的荷兰大师。

sentences.en: The first unknown
sentences.zh: 这是42年来首次面世的未知

sentences.en: Rembrandt to come to light in 42 years.
sentences.zh: 伦勃朗画作。

sentences.en: The find didn't come about from scouring remote churches or picking through the attics of European country houses, but rather, as Six described it to me last May,
sentences.zh: 这一发现并非来自搜寻偏远的教堂或翻找欧洲乡村住宅的阁楼，正如西克斯去年五月向我描述的那样，

sentences.en: while he was going through his mail.
sentences.zh: 当时他正在处理邮件。

sentences.en: He had just taken his two small children to school in true Dutch fashion by bicycle, one seated between the handlebars and the other in back.
sentences.zh: 他刚刚以典型的荷兰方式骑自行车送两个小孩上学，一个坐在车把之间，另一个坐在后面。

sentences.en: The typical weather for the season, raw wind and spitting rain would never deter a real Amsterdamer from mounting his bike,
sentences.zh: 那个季节典型的天气，刺骨的寒风和细雨，永远无法阻止真正的阿姆斯特丹人骑车出行，

sentences.en: and Six's roots in the city go about as deep as possible.
sentences.zh: 而西克斯在城里的根基深厚得不能再深了。

sentences.en: But by the time he arrived at his office, he was feeling the effects.
sentences.zh: 但当他到达办公室时，他已经感受到了寒意。

sentences.en: Waterkout, water cold, is the Dutch word for the chilly dampness of the low countries that seeps into the bones.
sentences.zh: Waterkout，即“水冷”，是荷兰语中用来形容低地国家那种渗入骨髓的阴冷潮湿。

sentences.en: The antidote to that feeling is encompassed in another word.
sentences.zh: 这种感觉的解药包含在另一个词里。

sentences.en: Cheselligheid, loosely translated as coziness, is the condition people in the Netherlands strive for in the interiors of their homes.
sentences.zh: Cheselligheid，大致翻译为“舒适”，是荷兰人努力追求的家居内部氛围。

sentences.en: It's often what's being depicted and celebrated in old master canvases from the golden age of the seventeenth century, the era that is Six's specialty.
sentences.zh: 这通常是17世纪黄金时代古典大师画布上所描绘和赞美的内容，那个时代正是西克斯的专长所在。

sentences.en: Warm domestic scenes, merry companies hoisting tankards, still lifes of tables laden with food.
sentences.zh: 温暖的家庭场景、举杯欢庆的聚会、摆满食物的静物画。

sentences.en: Six's office, on the ground floor of a building on the Heerenchacht, one of the city's main canals, a canal that Rembrandt himself used to stroll, has its share of Cheselligheid.
sentences.zh: 西克斯的办公室位于绅士运河（Heerenchacht）边一栋建筑的底层，这是该市的主要运河之一，伦勃朗本人也曾在此漫步，这里充满了Cheselligheid。

sentences.en: The building dates from the early 1600s.
sentences.zh: 这栋建筑始建于17世纪初。

sentences.en: Ancient beams cross the ceiling.
sentences.zh: 古老的横梁横跨天花板。

sentences.en: The views out of the windows are of bicyclists racing by, and the evocative, ever-somber surface of the canal reflecting the gabled facades of the buildings on the opposite side.
sentences.zh: 窗外可以看到飞驰而过的自行车，以及运河那引人入胜、永远忧郁的水面，倒映着对岸建筑的山墙立面。

sentences.en: Six made coffee that morning, then sat down to a stack of mail.
sentences.zh: 那天早上，西克斯煮了咖啡，然后坐下来处理一堆邮件。

sentences.en: He dispensed with the bills and other annoyances first, so as to settle into the catalogues of coming art auctions.
sentences.zh: 他先处理了账单和其他琐事，以便静下心来阅读即将举行的艺术拍卖会目录。

sentences.en: One was for a December event at Christie's in London.
sentences.zh: 其中一本是关于伦敦佳士得12月的一场活动。

sentences.en: He skimmed it quickly, almost dismissively.
sentences.zh: 他快速浏览了一遍，几乎是不屑一顾。

sentences.en: It was for the daytime sale, which featured lesser objects.
sentences.zh: 那是日间拍卖，主要是一些次要物品。

sentences.en: The top paintings and sculptures are always reserved for the evening.
sentences.zh: 顶级的画作和雕塑总是留给晚间拍卖。

sentences.en: And then, he told me, he stopped cold.
sentences.zh: 然后，他告诉我，他突然停住了。

sentences.en: The slightly miscolored photograph in the catalog was a portrait of a rather dazed-looking young gentleman with a lace collar and a proto-led zeppelin coif.
sentences.zh: 目录中那张略微变色的照片是一位看起来有些茫然的年轻绅士的肖像，他戴着蕾丝领子，留着类似齐柏林飞艇风格的发型。

sentences.en: What first spoke to Six was the gaze of the subject, whose identity remains unknown.
sentences.zh: 首先打动西克斯的是画中人的目光，其身份至今未知。

sentences.en: He pierces the image, he said.
sentences.zh: 他说，他穿透了画面。

sentences.en: Six felt that he had seen the work before, but after tearing through his library in search of it, he came to believe it wasn't the actual image
sentences.zh: 西克斯觉得他以前见过这幅作品，但在翻遍图书馆寻找它之后，他开始相信，让他感到熟悉的并不是这幅图像本身，

sentences.en: that struck him as familiar, but the sum of all the telltale features of an early Rembrandt.
sentences.zh: 而是早期伦勃朗所有标志性特征的总和。

sentences.en: These include, in Six's estimation, the humanness of that gaze, a rounded brushstroke, and a willingness to employ different painting styles within the same work.
sentences.zh: 在西克斯看来，这些特征包括那种目光中的人性、圆润的笔触，以及在同一作品中运用不同绘画风格的意愿。

sentences.en: The painting dated from somewhere between 1633 and 1635.
sentences.zh: 这幅画创作于1633年至1635年之间。

sentences.en: The giveaway was the particular type of lace collar, which was the height of fashion in that brief span and then quickly went out of style.
sentences.zh: 关键线索是那种特殊的蕾丝领子，它在那个短暂的时间段里是时尚巅峰，随后很快就过时了。

sentences.en: What especially excited Six was not just that Christie's had failed to see that the painting was most likely from the hand of the master, but also that the auction house had
sentences.zh: 让西克斯特别兴奋的不仅是佳士得没有看出这幅画极有可能是出自大师之手，还在于拍卖行将其

sentences.en: labeled it Circle of Rembrandt, i.e. from a follower.
sentences.zh: 标记为“伦勃朗圈内人”，即追随者的作品。

sentences.en: You see the problem, right?
sentences.zh: 你明白问题所在了吧？

sentences.en: He asked me.
sentences.zh: 他问我。

sentences.en: I was puzzling for the solution to the riddle when he blurted it out.
sentences.zh: 我还在苦思冥想这个谜题的答案时，他脱口而出。

sentences.en: Rembrandt wasn't famous yet in the early 1600s, so there was no circle.
sentences.zh: 17世纪初伦勃朗还没出名，所以根本没有所谓的“圈内人”。

sentences.en: I knew right away Christie's had screwed up.
sentences.zh: 我立刻就知道佳士得搞砸了。

sentences.en: From there,
sentences.zh: 从那时起，

sentences.en: Six was a bloodhound on the trail.
sentences.zh: 西克斯就像一只嗅觉灵敏的猎犬。

sentences.en: He learned that the painting's provenance went back to Sir Richard
sentences.zh: 他了解到这幅画的来源可以追溯到理查德·内夫爵士，

sentences.en: Neve, an English merchant of the late 1700s, who built a serious art collection, which included works of Thomas Gainsborough and John Constable.
sentences.zh: 一位18世纪末的英国商人，他建立了一个重要的艺术收藏，其中包括托马斯·庚斯博罗和约翰·康斯特布尔的作品。

sentences.en: The painting had stayed in the same family for six generations.
sentences.zh: 这幅画在同一个家族中传承了六代。

sentences.en: This fit.
sentences.zh: 这很合理。

sentences.en: It made sense that a painting by a top-tier artist would have attracted a prominent collector.
sentences.zh: 顶级艺术家的画作吸引了显赫的收藏家是说得通的。

sentences.en: Six was so excited that he jumped on his bike and cycled a short distance across
sentences.zh: 西克斯太兴奋了，他跳上自行车，穿过

sentences.en: central Amsterdam to the home of Ernst van der Weetering, universally renowned as a top authority on
sentences.zh: 阿姆斯特丹市中心，骑了一小段路来到恩斯特·范·德·韦特林（Ernst van der Weetering）的家，他被公认为伦勃朗研究的顶级权威。

sentences.en: Rembrandt.
sentences.zh: 伦勃朗。

sentences.en: Still breathless, Six thrust a photocopy of the picture at him.
sentences.zh: 西克斯气喘吁吁地把照片的复印件塞给他。

sentences.en: As befits a person whose opinion is weighted with import, van der Weetering typically reacts with reserve on first seeing an image, but he was intrigued.
sentences.zh: 正如一位意见举足轻重的人所应有的表现，范·德·韦特林在初次看到图像时通常反应谨慎，但他被吸引住了。

sentences.en: It looked like a Rembrandt, but it was completely new to me, van der Weetering told me later.
sentences.zh: “看起来像伦勃朗，但我完全没见过，”范·德·韦特林后来告诉我。

sentences.en: Six cycled back home and bought a plane ticket.
sentences.zh: 西克斯骑车回家，买了一张机票。

sentences.en: There were a few people in the Christie's London showroom when he arrived, Six told me.
sentences.zh: 西克斯告诉我，他到达时，佳士得伦敦展厅里还有几个人。

sentences.en: So he looked at other paintings until they left, then made his way to the portrait, studied it, and took pictures of it.
sentences.zh: 所以他先看了看其他画作，等他们离开后，他走到那幅肖像画前，仔细研究并拍了照。

sentences.en: I was shocked, because it had a different appearance in person, he said.
sentences.zh: “我惊呆了，因为它亲眼看起来完全不同，”他说。

sentences.en: It had far more depth.
sentences.zh: 它有更深的深度。

sentences.en: Six was particularly drawn to the lace on the collar.
sentences.zh: 西克斯特别被领子上的蕾丝所吸引。

sentences.en: Lace was a signifier of status throughout the seventeenth century, and Six believes Rembrandt had a signature way of depicting this variety, which is called bobbin lace.
sentences.zh: 蕾丝在整个17世纪都是地位的象征，西克斯认为伦勃朗有一种标志性的方式来描绘这种被称为“梭织蕾丝”的品种。

sentences.en: Other artists of the period, painstakingly executed its intricacies in white paint on top of the jacket.
sentences.zh: 那个时期的其他艺术家在夹克上用白色颜料费力地勾勒出其复杂细节。

sentences.en: Rembrandt did something like the opposite.
sentences.zh: 伦勃朗的做法恰恰相反。

sentences.en: He first painted the jacket, then over it the collar area in white, then used black paint to create the negative spaces in the collar.
sentences.zh: 他先画夹克，然后在上面画出白色的领子区域，再用黑色颜料在领子中创造出负空间。

sentences.en: And where other painters were careful to create repeating patterns in the lacework, Rembrandt wove a freestyle design.
sentences.zh: 而且，当其他画家小心翼翼地在蕾丝中创造重复图案时，伦勃朗编织了一种自由风格的设计。

sentences.en: For viewers standing a few inches away from such a painting, the collar appears as a hieroglyphic jumble.
sentences.zh: 对于站在离画作几英寸远的观众来说，领子看起来像是一堆象形文字的混乱组合。

sentences.en: Step back a pace, and it coheres.
sentences.zh: 退后一步，它就融为一体了。

sentences.en: Six believes this was one aspect of Rembrandt's genius.
sentences.zh: 西克斯认为这是伦勃朗天才的一面。

sentences.en: He realized that a painted copy of a repetitive pattern, even if it followed the original, actually looked artificial.
sentences.zh: 他意识到，即使忠实于原作，重复图案的绘画复制品看起来也显得人工化。

sentences.en: After he left the Christie's showroom, Six went around the corner to an art book shop, where he found a corpus of Rembrandt paintings, the authoritative guide to the entire oeuvre.
sentences.zh: 离开佳士得展厅后，西克斯去了街角的一家艺术书店，在那里他找到了一本伦勃朗画作全集，这是了解其全部作品的权威指南。

sentences.en: He flipped through the works of the 1630s and stopped when he came to what he was looking for.
sentences.zh: 他翻阅了1630年代的作品，当看到他要找的东西时停了下来。

sentences.en: Rembrandt's Portrait of Philippe Lucas, from 1635.
sentences.zh: 伦勃朗1635年的《菲利普·卢卡斯肖像》。

sentences.en: The original was conveniently located just across town in the National Gallery.
sentences.zh: 原作就在城另一头的国家美术馆里。

sentences.en: So he ran over there, and before long he was standing in front of it, gazing back and forth from the painting to the image on his camera, feeling his blood race as a
sentences.zh: 于是他跑了过去，没过多久他就站在画前，在画作和相机里的图像之间来回凝视，感受着血液加速流动，因为一个直觉固化成了近乎确定性的事实。

sentences.en: hunch solidified into near certainty.
sentences.zh: “我知道，无论谁画了这幅，也画了那幅，”他说。

sentences.en: I knew that whoever painted this, painted that, he said.
sentences.zh: 扬·西克斯是一位身材高挑、苗条，穿着打扮几乎无可挑剔的男士，他习惯性的表情中带着一丝背负重担的感觉。

sentences.en: Jan Six is a tall, slim, almost apologetically dapper man, whose customary expression contains a hint of someone carrying a burden.
sentences.zh: 这个重担原来就是他的名字，他实际上是第十一代扬·西克斯。

sentences.en: The burden turns out to be his name, which is actually Jan Six XI.
sentences.zh: 追溯到四个世纪前，他的贵族家庭几乎每一代长子都取名为扬。

sentences.en: Dating back four centuries, his aristocratic family has named a firstborn son Jan in nearly every generation.
sentences.zh: 第一代扬·西克斯是一位艺术、文化和政治人物，是荷兰黄金时代的真正代表，

sentences.en: The first Jan Six, a man of art, culture, and politics, was a true representative of the Dutch
sentences.zh: 那个时代，艺术、科学和商业的创造力爆发，将这个小国推向了欧洲生活和思想的前沿。

sentences.en: Golden Age, the period in which an explosion of creativity in art, science, and commerce vaulted the tiny nation to the forefront of European life and thought.
sentences.zh: 那位扬·西克斯实际上是伟大的伦勃朗·范·莱因的朋友。

sentences.en: That Jan Six was actually a friend of the great Rembrandt von Rhein.
sentences.zh: 当他在1650年代的某个时候决定请人画肖像时，他请伦勃朗担此重任。

sentences.en: When he decided, sometime in the 1650s, to have his portrait painted, he asked Rembrandt to do the honors.
sentences.zh: 结果是大师最受赞誉的作品之一，一幅令人惊叹的、沉思的、关于中年自我意识成熟度的研究，采用了后期伦勃朗标志性的粗犷笔触。

sentences.en: The result is one of the master's most admired works, a wondrously brooding study of self-aware, middle-aged sophistication, done in the hallmark
sentences.zh: 历史学家西蒙·沙玛称其为

sentences.zh: “17世纪最伟大的肖像画”。

sentences.en: The historian Simon Schama has called it
sentences.zh: 第一代扬·西克斯收藏了大量不同艺术家的绘画、雕塑和素描，但伦勃朗是西克斯收藏的核心。

sentences.en: The Greatest Portrait of the Seventeenth Century.
sentences.zh: 除了目前的保险估值超过4亿美元的扬·西克斯肖像画外，还有一幅第一代扬·西克斯母亲安娜·韦默的伦勃朗全尺寸油画，以及五幅素描和五十幅艺术家的原创蚀刻版画。

sentences.en: The first Jan Six amassed a large collection of paintings, sculptures, and drawings by a variety of artists, but Rembrandt is at the heart of the
sentences.zh: 随着西克斯收藏一代代传下去，它逐渐加入了维米尔、勃鲁盖尔、哈尔斯和鲁本斯的作品，以及偶尔出现的提香和丁托列托的作品。

sentences.en: Six collection.
sentences.zh: 在此过程中，一大堆虽然次要但仍具有历史意义的文物也附带其中。

sentences.en: In addition to the Jan Six portrait, which currently holds an insurance valuation of more
