sentences.en: than 400 million dollars, there is a full-scale Rembrandt oil painting of the first Jan Six's mother,
sentences.zh: 但画作始终是收藏的灵魂所在，多年来，西克斯家族表现出追随祖先倾向的趋势。

sentences.en: Anna Weimer, along with five drawings and fifty original etchings by the artiSt.
sentences.zh: 该收藏现在拥有不少于270幅家庭成员的肖像画。

sentences.en: As the sixth collection passed down from one generation to the next, it grew to include works by Vermeer, Bruegel, Hals, and Rubens, as well as the odd Titian and Tintoretto.
sentences.zh: 随着世纪流逝，其他伟大的欧洲家族艺术收藏被拆散，博物馆成为此类物品的主要存放地。

sentences.en: Along the way, a pirate's horde of lesser but still historically significant artifacts became attached to it.
sentences.zh: 而一直保留在西克斯家族住宅中的西克斯收藏，其神秘感却与日俱增。

sentences.en: Furniture, gems, medals, manuscripts, closets full of silver, Venetian glassware, ivory-handled toothbrushes, a diamond ring given to a family member by Tsar Alexander I.
sentences.zh: 家具、宝石、奖章、手稿、装满银器的柜子、威尼斯玻璃器皿、象牙柄牙刷、沙皇亚历山大一世送给家庭成员的钻石戒指。

sentences.en: But the paintings were always the raison d'etre of the collection, and over the years the Six's showed a tendency to follow their progenitors' inclination.
sentences.zh: 但画作始终是收藏的灵魂所在，多年来，西克斯家族表现出追随祖先倾向的趋势。

sentences.en: The collection now holds no fewer than 270 portraits of family members.
sentences.zh: 该收藏现在拥有不少于270幅家庭成员的肖像画。

sentences.en: As the centuries rolled on and other great European family art holdings were broken up and museums became the principal repositories for such things.
sentences.zh: 随着世纪流逝，其他伟大的欧洲家族艺术收藏被拆散，博物馆成为此类物品的主要存放地。

sentences.en: The Six collection, which remains in the Six family home, grew in mystique.
sentences.zh: 而一直保留在西克斯家族住宅中的西克斯收藏，其神秘感却与日俱增。

sentences.en: By tradition, each generation's Jan Six becomes the caretaker of the collection and the occupant of the house, for the last century a rambling 56-room mansion on the
sentences.zh: 按照传统，每一代的扬·西克斯（Jan Six）都会成为该家族藏品的保管人和这座宅邸的主人。在过去的一个世纪里，这座宅邸一直是一栋拥有56个房间、错落有致的豪宅，坐落在

sentences.en: Amstel River in the heart of Amsterdam.
sentences.zh: 阿姆斯特丹市中心的阿姆斯特尔河畔。

sentences.en: But Jan XI, the art dealer, is not that Jan.
sentences.zh: 但身为艺术品商人的第十一代扬·西克斯，并不是那位“扬”。

sentences.en: Not yet, anyway.
sentences.zh: 至少目前还不是。

sentences.en: His father, Jan X, or as he prefers to be called Baron J.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲，第十代扬·西克斯，或者按他自己喜欢的称呼——扬·西克斯·冯·希利霍姆男爵（Baron J. Six von Hillichom），

sentences.en: Six von Hillichom, still reigns.
sentences.zh: 依然掌管着一切。

sentences.en: The elder Six, who is 71, is known in cultural circles as both a deeply private man, he declined to be interviewed for this article, and a somewhat prickly one.
sentences.zh: 这位71岁的老西克斯在文化圈内以极其低调（他拒绝接受本文采访）且有些古怪难相处而闻名。

sentences.en: Nearly everyone I spoke to used the word difficult to describe him.
sentences.zh: 我采访过的几乎每个人在描述他时，都用了“难以相处”这个词。

sentences.en: I met the elder Six nine years ago when I was researching a book about the history of Amsterdam and wanted to see the inside of the famous Six house.
sentences.zh: 九年前，当我正在研究一本关于阿姆斯特丹历史的书，并希望参观著名的西克斯宅邸内部时，我见到了老西克斯。

sentences.en: After a typical Dutch lunch of sandwiches and milk in a kitchen that seemed right out of a Vermeer painting, dark woodwork, tile floors, angled light.
sentences.zh: 那是一顿典型的荷兰式午餐，有三明治和牛奶，厨房看起来就像直接从维米尔的画作中走出来的一样：深色的木制品、瓷砖地板，还有斜射进来的光线。

sentences.en: He took me through his home, a delightful warren of halls and old rooms stuffed with curios, some of them priceless.
sentences.zh: 他带着我参观了他的家，那是一个令人愉悦的迷宫，到处都是走廊和堆满古董的旧房间，其中一些价值连城。

sentences.en: Though display rooms and living quarters were separate, the feeling of being simultaneously in a home and a museum was palpable.
sentences.zh: 尽管展示厅和生活区是分开的，但那种同时置身于家中和博物馆的感觉非常明显。

sentences.en: You turned from admiring a Franz Hals, to notice splayed book and reading glasses on a side table, or a broom and dust pan in the corner.
sentences.zh: 你刚从欣赏一幅弗兰斯·哈尔斯（Franz Hals）的作品中转过身，就会注意到边桌上摊开的书和老花镜，或者角落里的扫帚和簸箕。

sentences.en: My overall impression from the visit was something out of a Thomas Mann novel.
sentences.zh: 那次参观给我留下的总体印象，就像是托马斯·曼小说里的场景。

sentences.en: Faded grandeur and an air of antique stillness, overseen by a wizened and mildly vexed Aristo.
sentences.zh: 褪色的辉煌和一种古老的静谧气息，由一位干瘪且略显烦躁的贵族所监管。

sentences.en: The elder Six may be known for his contentiousness, but regarding his most public battle, a multi-year
sentences.zh: 老西克斯或许以其好争辩而闻名，但关于他最公开的一场争端——一场持续多年的

sentences.en: lawsuit against the Dutch government for failing to live up to an agreement to pay for maintenance of the house, some people say he had a point.
sentences.zh: 针对荷兰政府的诉讼，起因是政府未能履行支付房屋维护费的协议——有些人认为他确实有理。

sentences.en: A left-wing politician thought it was ridiculous to give money to a family that's rich, and so he stopped the subsidy, said Fritz Duparc, former director of
sentences.zh: “一位左翼政客认为给一个富裕家庭提供资金是荒谬的，于是他停止了补贴，”曾担任该纠纷调解人的海牙莫瑞泰斯皇家美术馆（Mauritshuis）前馆长弗里茨·杜帕克（Fritz Duparc）说。

sentences.en: the Moritz House Museum in The Hague, who served as a mediator in the dispute.
sentences.zh: （接上文）

sentences.en: But the fact is the family isn't so rich because the art was long ago put into a foundation.
sentences.zh: 但事实是，这个家庭并没有那么富有，因为艺术品早在很久以前就被放入了一个基金会中。

sentences.en: The foundation was created in part to keep the art together and thus in the country.
sentences.zh: 建立该基金会的部分原因是为了将艺术品集中在一起，从而留在国内。

sentences.en: In the past, the family had been forced to sell Vermeers and other national treasures in order to pay tax bills.
sentences.zh: 过去，该家族曾被迫出售维米尔的作品和其他国宝来支付税单。

sentences.en: Eventually, in 2008, the lawsuit was settled and an agreement reached.
sentences.zh: 最终，在2008年，诉讼达成和解，双方达成了一项协议。

sentences.en: A foundation owns the Six mansion, the family has a right to live in it in perpetuity, and the state provides funds for its upkeep.
sentences.zh: 基金会拥有西克斯宅邸，家族拥有永久居住权，而国家则提供维护资金。

sentences.en: In exchange, the Sixes are to provide limited public access to the collection.
sentences.zh: 作为交换，西克斯家族必须向公众提供有限的参观机会。

sentences.en: Jan Six's obsession with Rembrandt, he calls it that, started with his childhood encounters with the master's portrait of his namesake in the blue salon in the Six family house.
sentences.zh: 扬·西克斯对伦勃朗的痴迷（他自己也这么说）始于他童年时期在西克斯家族宅邸的蓝色沙龙里，与大师为他同名的祖先所画的肖像画的邂逅。

sentences.en: Six can talk about Rembrandt endlessly, absorbingly, and with great feeling.
sentences.zh: 西克斯谈起伦勃朗时，总是滔滔不绝、引人入胜，且充满深情。

sentences.en: What sets Rembrandt apart is his ability to paint the person, he told me.
sentences.zh: “伦勃朗的过人之处在于他描绘人物的能力，”他告诉我。

sentences.en: When I go through a museum and there's a Rembrandt, I'll pass it the way you do a person, looking out of the corner of my eye, thinking, oh, who's that?
sentences.zh: “当我在博物馆里走动，看到一幅伦勃朗的作品时，我会像对待一个人那样经过它，用眼角的余光看着，心想：噢，那是谁？”

sentences.en: Like it might be somebody I know.
sentences.zh: “就像那可能是我认识的人一样。”

sentences.en: It's a living human being.
sentences.zh: “那是一个活生生的人。”

sentences.en: By contrast, he doesn't think much of the other titan of the Dutch Golden Age.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，他并不怎么看好荷兰黄金时代的另一位巨匠。

sentences.en: I know a lot of Americans love Vermeer.
sentences.zh: “我知道很多美国人喜欢维米尔。”

sentences.en: I personally don't like him.
sentences.zh: “我个人不喜欢他。”

sentences.en: It's a trick, optical stuff.
sentences.zh: “那是一种戏法，是光学上的把戏。”

sentences.en: I think if you put Girl with a Pearl Earring next to any Rembrandt, you'll see the difference.
sentences.zh: “我想如果你把《戴珍珠耳环的少女》和任何一幅伦勃朗的作品放在一起，你就会看出区别。”

sentences.en: Among the many reasons for the centuries of popular enthrallment with Rembrandt, the tremendous volume, range, and quality of the work
sentences.zh: 几个世纪以来，人们对伦勃朗如此着迷的原因有很多：他作品的巨大数量、广度与质量，

sentences.en: he produced, the plethora of styles he experimented with, his own complex biography.
sentences.zh: 他尝试过的多种风格，以及他本人复杂的生平。

sentences.en: Maybe the most trenchant is the psychological insight he brought to bear on his subjects, the way his figures seem to
sentences.zh: 也许最深刻的原因是他带给画中人物的心理洞察力，他笔下的人物似乎能

sentences.en: engage the viewer, to pull you into the particular struggle of that moment in their lives.
sentences.zh: 与观众互动，将你拉入他们生命中那一刻的特定挣扎之中。

sentences.en: This focus on the individual was a defining feature of the artist's era.
sentences.zh: 这种对个人的关注是那个时代艺术家的一个决定性特征。

sentences.en: The Dutch Golden Age marked a turn away from strictly religious subjects.
sentences.zh: 荷兰黄金时代标志着人们开始远离纯粹的宗教题材。

sentences.en: Suddenly, people were interested in ordinary life and in themselves, and artists followed suit.
sentences.zh: 突然间，人们对普通生活和自身产生了兴趣，艺术家们也随之效仿。

sentences.en: Portrait painting became an industry, but Rembrandt went one better than his contemporaries.
sentences.zh: 肖像画成为了一种产业，但伦勃朗比他的同时代人更胜一筹。

sentences.en: Many of them could paint what you looked like.
sentences.zh: 他们中的许多人都能画出你的长相。

sentences.en: What made Rembrandt so special to the citizens of Amsterdam, who lined up to commission
sentences.zh: 而对于排队委托他绘制肖像的阿姆斯特丹市民来说，伦勃朗之所以如此特别，

sentences.en: him to paint their portraits, was that he seemed to be able to go beneath the surface, to get at who you were.
sentences.zh: 是因为他似乎能够深入表象之下，触及你灵魂的本质。

sentences.en: That empathy may stem not only from Rembrandt's genius, but also from his own life.
sentences.zh: 这种同理心可能不仅源于伦勃朗的天才，也源于他自己的人生经历。

sentences.en: Early on, he became the most celebrated painter of the day, but he refused to follow shifting fashions and fell from favour.
sentences.zh: 早年，他成为了当时最著名的画家，但他拒绝追随不断变化的时尚，最终失宠。

sentences.en: He overspent, going heavily into debt.
sentences.zh: 他入不敷出，背负了沉重的债务。

sentences.en: He lost his wife not long after she gave birth and started a relationship with his baby's nursemaid, which he tried to extricate
sentences.zh: 他在妻子产后不久便失去了她，并开始与孩子的保姆建立关系，他试图通过将该女子送进精神病院来摆脱

sentences.en: himself from by having the woman committed to an asylum.
sentences.zh: 这段关系。

sentences.en: Then he went bankrupt.
sentences.zh: 随后他破产了。

sentences.en: He seems to have lived his last years in a misery of his own making.
sentences.zh: 他似乎在自己造成的痛苦中度过了晚年。

sentences.en: If the Dutch golden age evinced a newly intimate focus on the individual, Rembrandt applied the dictum to himself ruthlessly.
sentences.zh: 如果说荷兰黄金时代展现了一种对个人全新的亲密关注，那么伦勃朗则无情地将这一准则应用到了自己身上。

sentences.en: His self-portraits, especially the later ones, are pitilessly honest explorations of the psychic toll we inflict on ourselves.
sentences.zh: 他的自画像，尤其是晚年的作品，是对我们施加于自身的心理创伤进行的无情而诚实的探索。

sentences.en: The walls of Six's Amsterdam studio are always lined with seventeenth-century portraits, works he has bought and is researching, or is having restored and preparing to resell.
sentences.zh: 西克斯在阿姆斯特丹的工作室墙上总是挂满了十七世纪的肖像画，这些都是他买来正在研究，或者正在修复并准备转售的作品。

sentences.en: When I showed up last summer, the painting from the Christie's catalogue, Portrait of a Young Gentleman, was hanging in a central spot.
sentences.zh: 去年夏天我出现时，那幅来自佳士得拍卖目录的《年轻绅士肖像》正挂在中心位置。

sentences.en: Six, who talks in a soothing murmur and refers to himself as a scholar-dealer, gave me a tour of it.
sentences.zh: 西克斯用一种舒缓的低语交谈，自称为“学者型艺术商”，他带我参观了这幅画。

sentences.en: I love the glove and the cuff, very elegant.
sentences.zh: “我喜欢这只手套和袖口，非常优雅。”

sentences.en: See the brush strokes?
sentences.zh: “看到这些笔触了吗？”

sentences.en: He started here and slowly moves to the right and makes a curve.
sentences.zh: “他从这里开始，慢慢向右移动，画出一条曲线。”

sentences.en: He adds these broad strokes.
sentences.zh: “他加上了这些宽大的笔触。”

sentences.en: Then he paints the cuff and the bit that's in the light is painted in color because he understands that in light you don't have black lines, but in shadows you do.
sentences.zh: “然后他画袖口，光线照到的部分用色彩描绘，因为他明白在光线下没有黑线，但在阴影里却有。”

sentences.en: He cleverly uses the way light actually shines on material.
sentences.zh: 他巧妙地利用了光线照射在材质上的真实方式。

sentences.en: Slowly it recedes into shadow.
sentences.zh: 它慢慢地退入阴影之中。

sentences.en: When I was working on my book about the history of
sentences.zh: 当我正在撰写关于阿姆斯特丹历史的书时，

sentences.en: Amsterdam, Six invited me here and conducted a remarkable little demonstration.
sentences.zh: 西克斯邀请我到这里，并进行了一次非凡的小演示。

sentences.en: He turned off the lights and lit candles, and in an instant the paintings were transformed.
sentences.zh: 他关掉灯，点燃蜡烛，瞬间，这些画作就发生了蜕变。

sentences.en: They took on new energy.
sentences.zh: 它们焕发出了新的活力。

sentences.en: The golds and reds and flesh tones became warmer.
sentences.zh: 金色、红色和肤色变得更加温暖。

sentences.en: The flicker of the flames seemed to breathe life into the two-dimensional figures.
sentences.zh: 摇曳的火焰似乎为这些二维的人物注入了生命。

sentences.en: Six's eyes gleamed as he saw that I had registered the point.
sentences.zh: 当西克斯看到我已经领会了这一点时，他的眼睛闪闪发光。

sentences.en: These paintings were made for candlelight.
sentences.zh: “这些画就是为烛光而作的。”

sentences.en: Six was helping me to experience the world of 17th century
sentences.zh: 西克斯正在帮助我以最切实的方式体验十七世纪

sentences.en: Amsterdamers in the most tangible way.
sentences.zh: 阿姆斯特丹人的世界。

sentences.en: The minute differences in ways of seeing and feeling that separate one historical epic from another.
sentences.zh: 那种将一个历史纪元与另一个历史纪元区分开来的、在观察和感受方式上的细微差别。

sentences.en: But I came to realize that he was also giving me an insight into something else.
sentences.zh: 但我逐渐意识到，他也在让我洞察另一件事。

sentences.en: His lifelong struggle with his family over what had expected of him as heir to the Six collection.
sentences.zh: 他一生都在与家人抗争，因为作为西克斯藏品的继承人，他被寄予了厚望。

sentences.en: When he was a boy, the greatness of the Western art tradition may have greeted him every day as he marched to breakfast, but it didn't thrill him with a sense of destiny.
sentences.zh: 当他还是个男孩时，西方艺术传统的伟大之处或许每天在他走向早餐桌时都在迎接他，但这并没有让他感到一种使命感。

sentences.en: Where previous heirs, who were avid collectors, though not art professionals, seemed to have accepted the responsibility with equanimity, Six pushed it away.
sentences.zh: 以前的继承人虽然是狂热的收藏家，但并非艺术专业人士，他们似乎平静地接受了这份责任，而西克斯却将其推开。

sentences.en: The Sixes are part of Dutch nobility, but as a teenager he tried not to be an aristocrat, his close friend David van Ede told me.
sentences.zh: “西克斯家族是荷兰贵族的一部分，但十几岁时，他极力想摆脱贵族身份，”他的好友大卫·范·埃德（David van Ede）告诉我。

sentences.en: He was a little bit embarrassed by it.
sentences.zh: “他对此感到有点尴尬。”

sentences.en: Rather than having Rembrandts and Bruegel's hanging in his bedroom, he went for posters,
sentences.zh: 他没有在卧室里挂伦勃朗和勃鲁盖尔的画，而是选择了海报，

sentences.en: Bob Marley and Guns and Roses.
sentences.zh: 鲍勃·马利（Bob Marley）和枪花乐队（Guns N' Roses）。

sentences.en: He hated high school, got a job as a cook in a restaurant, and thought for a time that becoming a chef might be his route of rebellion.
sentences.zh: 他讨厌高中，在一家餐馆找了份厨师的工作，一度认为成为一名厨师可能是他反叛的途径。

sentences.en: When his parents were away, he would host parties in the mansion.
sentences.zh: 当父母不在家时，他会在豪宅里举办派对。

sentences.en: We were there practically every weekend, van Ede said.
sentences.zh: “我们几乎每个周末都在那儿，”范·埃德说。

sentences.en: We didn't swing from the chandeliers, but we would smoke, drink Heinekens, go out to a hip-hop club, stop at Burger King, then maybe go back to Jan's place and sleep.
sentences.zh: “我们没有在吊灯上荡秋千，但我们会抽烟、喝喜力啤酒、去嘻哈俱乐部、在汉堡王停下，然后可能回到扬的住处睡觉。”

sentences.en: Sometimes we set off the alarMs.
sentences.zh: “有时我们会触发警报。”

sentences.en: Sixes knew what was expected of him, but bristled.
sentences.zh: 西克斯知道大家对他的期望，但他感到恼火。

sentences.en: Nobody wants to be pushed into a corner, he told me.
sentences.zh: “没人想被逼到角落里，”他告诉我。

sentences.en: You hear all your life that everything you do is in preparation to follow in the Jan's six footsteps.
sentences.zh: “你一生都在听人说，你所做的一切都是为了追随扬·西克斯的脚步。”

sentences.en: But hey, I'm an individual.
sentences.zh: “但嘿，我是一个独立的个体。”

sentences.en: He came around, however, at least partly, when he started to interact with the people who showed up at the front door, tickets in hand, to take tours of his home.
sentences.zh: 然而，当他开始与那些手持门票、来到前门参观他家的人互动时，他至少在一定程度上转变了态度。

sentences.en: It was these ordinary folk who made Six realize that art was his calling.
sentences.zh: 正是这些普通人让西克斯意识到艺术是他的使命。

sentences.en: Sometimes a tour guide would be sick and I would help out, he said.
sentences.zh: “有时导游生病了，我会帮忙，”他说。

sentences.en: At first I was scared.
sentences.zh: “起初我很害怕。”

sentences.en: Then I saw how happy and interested the people were.
sentences.zh: “然后我看到了人们是多么开心和感兴趣。”

sentences.en: And when they learned that I was Jan Six and they looked from me to Rembrandt's portrait of the other Jan Six, I saw them getting excited, connecting the past and present.
sentences.zh: “当他们得知我是扬·西克斯，并从我看向伦勃朗画的另一位扬·西克斯肖像时，我看到他们变得兴奋起来，连接了过去与现在。”

sentences.en: Some of the visitors knew a lot about art and I listened to them.
sentences.zh: 有些游客对艺术了解很多，我便倾听他们的见解。

sentences.en: He began looking at the paintings in a new way.
sentences.zh: 他开始以一种新的方式审视这些画作。

sentences.en: They went from being flat representations of dead people to aesthetic expressions serving as portals into history.
sentences.zh: 它们不再是死人的平面画像，而是作为通往历史之门的审美表达。

sentences.en: In particular, that Rembrandt's portrait of the first Jan Six took hold of him.
sentences.zh: 特别是那幅伦勃朗画的第一代扬·西克斯肖像，深深地吸引了他。

sentences.en: I realized that it matters to me that the eyes in that painting are genetically my eyes.
sentences.zh: “我意识到，画中那双眼睛在基因上就是我的眼睛，这对我来说意义重大。”

sentences.en: Six tried to free himself from the burden of his legacy by embracing the art that is the basis of it, but engaging with it on his
sentences.zh: 西克斯试图通过拥抱作为其遗产基础的艺术来摆脱负担，但他是以自己的方式与艺术互动。

sentences.en: own terMs. He studied art history in college, then was hired by Sotheby's in London as a junior specialist in old masters.
sentences.zh: 他在大学学习了艺术史，随后被伦敦苏富比拍卖行聘为古典大师作品的初级专家。

sentences.en: He was good at the job and moved easily in the world of international wealth and culture.
sentences.zh: 他工作出色，在国际财富和文化圈中游刃有余。

sentences.en: Over time, it seemed, a family gene kicked in.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，似乎家族基因发挥了作用。

sentences.en: Geert Mach, a Dutch author who wrote a history of the Six family, told me that some of the earlier Jan Sixes had an extraordinarily acute
sentences.zh: 撰写了西克斯家族史的荷兰作家海尔特·马赫（Geert Mak）告诉我，早期的几位扬·西克斯拥有极其敏锐的

sentences.en: visual sense, which guided them as they amassed their collection.
sentences.zh: 视觉感官，这引导他们在积累藏品时做出了选择。

sentences.en: This Jan Six has it too, he said.
sentences.zh: “这一代扬·西克斯也有这种天赋，”他说。

sentences.en: It's an exceptional talent to see through a painting, to remember a gesture from another painting he saw years earlier, an unbelievable memory for small details.
sentences.zh: “这是一种非凡的才能，能看透画作，能记住多年前看过的另一幅画中的姿态，对微小细节有着令人难以置信的记忆力。”

sentences.en: As he grew in his profession, Six came to feel he had a right to express himself on the family collection.
sentences.zh: 随着职业生涯的发展，西克斯开始觉得他有权对家族藏品表达自己的见解。

sentences.en: A series of clashes with his father ensued, many of them about providing greater public access, which has always been a difficulty.
sentences.zh: 随后他与父亲发生了一系列冲突，其中许多是关于提供更多公众参观机会的问题，这一直是个难题。

sentences.en: Currently, tours of the collection, which are by appointment only, are booked into next year.
sentences.zh: 目前，仅限预约的藏品参观行程已经排到了明年。

sentences.en: The picture that the younger Six sketched was of an inward-looking father, who was trying to preserve a legacy by keeping the world at bay, who comes to realize over time that he
sentences.zh: 年轻的西克斯勾勒出的画面是一位内向的父亲，他试图通过拒世界于门外来保护遗产，但他逐渐意识到，

sentences.en: also has to do battle with a gregarious and extroverted son, who feels that the way to preserve that legacy is precisely by sharing it with the wider world.
sentences.zh: 他也必须与一个善于交际、外向的儿子抗争，儿子认为保护遗产的方法恰恰是与更广阔的世界分享它。

sentences.en: The battles left the younger Six progressively more exasperated.
sentences.zh: 这些争斗让年轻的西克斯越来越感到愤怒。

sentences.en: I would cycle home after and think, Jesus, Dad, I'm trying to help you.
sentences.zh: “我之后会骑车回家，心想：天哪，爸爸，我是在帮你。”

sentences.en: One of these disagreements centered on, of all things, picture frames.
sentences.zh: 其中一次分歧竟然是关于画框的。

sentences.en: Some of the great paintings in the collection, including the portrait of Jan Six, have ornamented gilded frames, which were put on them
sentences.zh: 藏品中的一些名画，包括扬·西克斯的肖像，都有装饰性的镀金画框，这些画框是十九世纪的西克斯家族成员在流行炫耀时装上去的。

sentences.en: by nineteenth-century Sixes when showiness was in fashion.
sentences.zh: （接上文）

sentences.en: Jan the Younger argued for returning them to their seventeenth-century look, which would have meant the smooth and sober black frames that he
sentences.zh: 年轻的扬主张让它们回归十七世纪的样貌，这意味着要换成他认为画作自然归属的朴素、庄重的黑色画框。

sentences.en: believed were the picture's natural habitat.
sentences.zh: （接上文）

sentences.en: This was the other point of the candlelight demonstration
sentences.zh: 这就是西克斯为我演示烛光效果的另一个目的。

sentences.en: Six gave me.
sentences.zh: （接上文）

sentences.en: If you put a gold frame around a Rembrandt, whatever is in the painting goes five meters to the back and whatever is gold becomes yellowish, he said.
sentences.zh: “如果你给伦勃朗的画装上金框，画中的一切都会向后退五米，而金色的东西会变得发黄，”他说。

sentences.en: The painting has to compete with the noise of the frame.
sentences.zh: “画作必须与画框的噪音竞争。”

sentences.en: Take away the noise and beauty will emerge.
sentences.zh: “消除噪音，美就会显现出来。”

sentences.en: His father, however, was adamant that the pictures in the collection should stay in the gold frames.
sentences.zh: 然而，他的父亲坚持认为藏品中的画作应该保留在金框中。

sentences.en: The Younger Six told me he believed his father feels his duty is to the collection, including the way his ancestors preserved it.
sentences.zh: 年轻的西克斯告诉我，他认为父亲觉得自己的职责是对藏品负责，包括他祖先保存藏品的方式。

sentences.en: If you live in a house for decades and see it as the core of your existence, you practically live for the house, he said, whereas he himself feels an obligation to the art.
sentences.zh: “如果你在一个房子里住了几十年，并把它视为你存在的核心，你几乎就是为房子而活，”他说，而他自己则感到对艺术负有义务。

sentences.en: To avoid more confrontations, six took a step back.
sentences.zh: 为了避免更多的冲突，西克斯退了一步。

sentences.en: I decided I would rather have a father as a friend, so the house and the collection have nothing to do with me.
sentences.zh: “我决定我宁愿要一个父亲作为朋友，所以房子和藏品与我无关。”

sentences.en: Our relationship is best when there's a distance.
sentences.zh: “保持距离时，我们的关系最好。”

sentences.en: As recently as 1991, paintings by artists of the Dutch Golden Age, the Italian Renaissance, and other major eras of European history dominated the international art market.
sentences.zh: 就在1991年，荷兰黄金时代、意大利文艺复兴以及欧洲历史其他主要时期的艺术家作品还主导着国际艺术市场。

sentences.en: But in a digital, now-oriented time in which there is a steady shift in the global balance of power,
sentences.zh: 但在一个数字化的、以当下为导向的时代，全球权力平衡正在发生持续的转变，

sentences.en: last year China became the second largest art market in the world, behind the United States,
sentences.zh: 去年中国成为仅次于美国的世界第二大艺术市场，

sentences.en: European old masters have come to seem old.
sentences.zh: 欧洲的古典大师作品开始显得过时了。

sentences.en: In 2018, 85% of the art news list of 200 top collectors said they collected contemporary art in one form or another.
sentences.zh: 2018年，艺术新闻列出的200位顶级收藏家中，85%的人表示他们以某种形式收藏当代艺术。

sentences.en: Only 6% said they collected old masters.
sentences.zh: 只有6%的人表示他们收藏古典大师作品。

sentences.en: And while the top names, Rembrandt, Titian, Raphael, still command top dollar, everything else has dropped in value.
sentences.zh: 虽然伦勃朗、提香、拉斐尔等顶级名字仍然价值连城，但其他一切作品的价值都已下降。

sentences.en: If you buy a minor painting for $3,000, it will probably be worth $2,000 down the line, said Otto Naumann, a prominent American art dealer now with Sotheby's.
sentences.zh: “如果你花3000美元买一幅次要的画，它以后可能只值2000美元，”现就职于苏富比的美国著名艺术品商奥托·诺曼（Otto Naumann）说。

sentences.en: You see a similar decline at the $300,000 range.
sentences.zh: 在30万美元的价位上，你也会看到类似的下滑。

sentences.en: Seascapes, Flemish still lives, many of these have diminished in value.
sentences.zh: 海景画、佛兰德斯静物画，这些作品的价值大多有所缩水。

sentences.en: Related to the decline in sales is the aging of the field.
sentences.zh: 与销售额下降相关的是该领域的日益老龄化。

sentences.en: There are hardly any younger collectors who are interested in the old masters, the former Moritz House director Fritz Duparc said.
sentences.zh: “几乎没有对古典大师感兴趣的年轻收藏家，”莫瑞泰斯皇家美术馆前馆长弗里茨·杜帕克说。

sentences.en: Most of the major collectors are in their 70s and 80s.
sentences.zh: “大多数主要收藏家都在70岁和80岁左右。”

sentences.en: There have been declines, too, in relevant university programs and faculty posts, and in curator positions at museuMs.
sentences.zh: 相关的大学课程和教职岗位，以及博物馆的策展职位也出现了减少。

sentences.en: Duparc said that in the Netherlands there is exactly one professor fully devoted to the field of golden age Dutch art.
sentences.zh: 杜帕克说，在荷兰，专门研究荷兰黄金时代艺术的教授只有一位。

sentences.en: Matthew Teitelbaum, the director of the Museum of Fine Arts in Boston,
sentences.zh: 波士顿美术馆馆长马修·泰特尔鲍姆，

sentences.en: says that a new center for Netherlandish art that his institution is developing will aim to counter this trend.
sentences.zh: 表示他的机构正在筹建一个新的荷兰艺术中心，旨在扭转这一趋势。

sentences.en: But he acknowledged the challenge.
sentences.zh: 但他承认这充满挑战。

sentences.en: Right now this is a narrowing field where university programs are declining and teaching appointments are being left unfilled.
sentences.zh: 目前，这是一个正在萎缩的领域，大学课程在减少，教职空缺也无人填补。

sentences.en: As for dealers devoted to old masters, Duparc noted that while a few decades ago there were dozens of independent dealers, now there are only a scattered few.
sentences.zh: 至于专门从事古典大师作品的艺术商，杜帕克指出，几十年前还有几十家独立艺术商，现在只剩下零星几家了。

sentences.en: Most of the trade has been taken up by the big auction houses, Sotheby's and Christie's.
sentences.zh: 大部分交易已被苏富比和佳士得等大型拍卖行占据。

sentences.en: Despite this inhospitable landscape, Jan Six decided in 2009 to set himself up as an independent dealer in Dutch Old Masters with a particular specialty in portraits.
sentences.zh: 尽管环境如此恶劣，扬·西克斯还是在2009年决定成为一名独立的荷兰古典大师作品艺术商，并特别专注于肖像画。

sentences.en: He says he had become leery of the corporate mentality he found at Sotheby's, which looked at the world's artistic heritage as a high-end commodity.
sentences.zh: 他说，他开始对在苏富比感受到的那种企业心态感到厌倦，那种心态将世界艺术遗产视为高端商品。

sentences.en: Most dealers are merchants, he said.
sentences.zh: 他说，大多数艺术商都是商人。

sentences.en: They could be car salesmen or traders on Wall Street.
sentences.zh: 他们可能是汽车销售员，也可能是华尔街的交易员。

sentences.en: I don't really think they're in it for the aesthetic high.
sentences.zh: 我不认为他们是为了追求审美上的快感而从事这一行。

sentences.en: He found an elegant studio library office space in Amsterdam, a few blocks from his parents and the family collection, and set up shop.
sentences.zh: 他在阿姆斯特丹找到了一间优雅的工作室兼图书馆办公室，离他父母和家族收藏的地方只有几个街区，于是便开了店。

sentences.en: Six flourished as a dealer.
sentences.zh: 西克斯作为艺术商事业蒸蒸日上。

sentences.en: He spent the next several years shuttling among New York, London,
sentences.zh: 接下来的几年里，他往返于纽约、伦敦、

sentences.en: Paris, and Amsterdam, buying and selling, developing trust and an ever more discerning eye.
sentences.zh: 巴黎和阿姆斯特丹之间，买卖艺术品，建立信任，并培养出愈发敏锐的眼光。

sentences.en: His name gave him ready access to the top collectors and the directors of the world's major art museuMs.
sentences.zh: 他的姓氏让他能轻易接触到顶级收藏家和世界各大艺术博物馆的馆长。

sentences.en: He became versed in the high-tech methods for analyzing paintings, which can yield details about canvas, wood, and pigment, that can offer insight into a work and its creator.
sentences.zh: 他精通高科技绘画分析方法，这些方法能提供关于画布、木材和颜料的细节，从而深入了解作品及其创作者。

sentences.en: He did well as a dealer, a hovert flink here, a heret von Hontorst there, but he felt he was biding his time.
sentences.zh: 他作为艺术商做得不错，这里买进一幅霍弗特·弗林克，那里买进一幅赫里特·范·洪特霍斯特，但他觉得自己是在等待时机。

sentences.en: What mattered to him was Rembrandt.
sentences.zh: 对他而言，重要的是伦勃朗。

sentences.en: Six worked doggedly to make himself an expert.
sentences.zh: 西克斯锲而不舍地努力让自己成为专家。

sentences.en: He began a pilgrimage to stand face to face with each of the 341 paintings by the master listed in the corpus, spread from Omaha, Nebraska to St. Petersburg, Russia.
sentences.zh: 他开始了一场朝圣之旅，去亲眼看看伦勃朗全集目录中列出的每一幅画作，这些画作散布在从内布拉斯加州奥马哈到俄罗斯圣彼得堡的各地。

sentences.en: He has seen 80% of them so far, and he amassed an archive of tens of thousands of documents and images related to the artiSt.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，他已经看过其中80%的作品，并积累了数万份与这位艺术家相关的文献和图像档案。

sentences.en: It's not too much to say that he takes Rembrandt personally.
sentences.zh: 说他把伦勃朗视为个人事业，一点也不为过。

sentences.en: When we first spoke about the portrait he discovered, he made it clear what finding it meant to him.
sentences.zh: 当我们第一次谈论他发现的那幅肖像画时，他明确表达了这一发现对他意味着什么。

sentences.en: This has nothing to do with my family, he asserted, which as he well knew was both narrowly true and utterly false.
sentences.zh: 这与我的家族无关，他断言道。正如他所清楚的那样，这句话既是狭义上的事实，也是彻头彻尾的谎言。

sentences.en: I want you to understand that this discovery is not about my father or the Six
sentences.zh: 我想让你明白，这个发现与我父亲或西克斯

sentences.en: Collection.
sentences.zh: 家族收藏无关。

sentences.en: It's pure catharsis.
sentences.zh: 这纯粹是一种宣泄。

sentences.en: For the first time in my life, it's just me and Rembrandt.
sentences.zh: 这是我人生中第一次，只有我和伦勃朗。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《纽约时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果可以免费试用一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息，你会去探索《纽约时报》吗？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间越过付费墙，看看时报订阅者每天都能看到什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载时报应用程序，获取30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: After studying the portrait of the young gentleman in the Christie's London showroom, Six flew back to Amsterdam and took the photographs he had shot to Ernst van der Wettering,
sentences.zh: 在研究了佳士得伦敦展厅里的那幅年轻绅士肖像画后，西克斯飞回阿姆斯特丹，把他拍摄的照片拿给恩斯特·范·德·韦特林看，

sentences.en: the Rembrandt scholar to whom he had shown the catalog image.
sentences.zh: 也就是那位他曾展示过目录图片的伦勃朗学者。

sentences.en: Van der Wettering was further intrigued, but he wouldn't say more at the time without seeing the thing itself.
sentences.zh: 范·德·韦特林对此产生了进一步的兴趣，但在亲眼见到实物之前，他当时不愿多说什么。

sentences.en: That was enough for Six.
sentences.zh: 这对西克斯来说已经足够了。

sentences.en: He was ready to bid.
sentences.zh: 他准备出价了。

sentences.en: The auction estimate was listed at $19,000 to $25,000, peanuts if the painting was what he thought it was.
sentences.zh: 拍卖估价为1.9万美元至2.5万美元，如果这幅画真是他所想的那样，这点钱简直是九牛一毛。

sentences.en: But if anyone else suspected what he did, the price would shoot up.
sentences.zh: 但如果其他人也猜到了他的想法，价格就会飙升。

sentences.en: Rembrandt's, of course, can sell in the tens or hundreds of millions.
sentences.zh: 当然，伦勃朗的作品可以卖到数千万甚至数亿美元。

sentences.en: In 2015, the Rijksmuseum, the great repository of Dutch art and history and the home of Rembrandt's night watch, in partnership with the Louvre, bought a
sentences.zh: 2015年，作为荷兰艺术和历史的伟大宝库、伦勃朗《夜巡》的所在地，荷兰国立博物馆与卢浮宫合作，

sentences.en: pair of full-length life-size portraits by Rembrandt of a wedding couple dated 1634, precisely within the period of Jan Six's find.
sentences.zh: 买下了一对伦勃朗创作于1634年的真人大小全身肖像画，这正好在扬·西克斯发现作品的时期内。

sentences.en: Each figure is wearing the tell-tale bobbin lace.
sentences.zh: 画中每个人都戴着标志性的梭芯蕾丝。

sentences.en: The museums paid $174 million for the pair.
sentences.zh: 两家博物馆为这对画作支付了1.74亿美元。

sentences.en: Six called an investor he had worked with in the past, he won't say whom, and got a go-ahead.
sentences.zh: 西克斯给一位过去合作过的投资者打了电话（他不愿透露是谁），并得到了准许。

sentences.en: Six told me the investor was willing to go as high as 4 million pounds, $5 million, which would still be a bargain for a Rembrandt.
sentences.zh: 西克斯告诉我，那位投资者愿意出价高达400万英镑（500万美元），对于伦勃朗的作品来说，这仍然很划算。

sentences.en: In the end, Six's winning bid was 137 pounds, $173,000.
sentences.zh: 最终，西克斯的成交价是13.7万英镑（17.3万美元）。

sentences.en: The price was about right for a circle of painting.
sentences.zh: 这个价格对于一幅“伦勃朗圈内人”的作品来说差不多。

sentences.en: Six had the painting cleaned, restored, and scientifically analyzed.
sentences.zh: 西克斯对这幅画进行了清洗、修复和科学分析。

sentences.en: For this, he went to the top team in the country for high-tech art analysis.
sentences.zh: 为此，他找到了全国最顶尖的高科技艺术分析团队。

sentences.en: Petria Noble, head of paintings conservation at the Rijksmuseum, told me that her lab did a micro-X-ray fluorescence scan of the painting.
sentences.zh: 荷兰国立博物馆绘画修复部门负责人佩特里亚·诺布尔告诉我，她的实验室对这幅画进行了微型X射线荧光扫描。

sentences.en: The technology that penetrates layers of paint and allows for a sophisticated analysis of a work, and thus of the artist's process, and also studied paint samples.
sentences.zh: 这种技术可以穿透油漆层，对作品进行复杂的分析，从而了解艺术家的创作过程，他们还研究了油漆样本。

sentences.en: Because the Rijksmuseum had, with the Louvre, recently purchased the pair of Rembrandt wedding portraits,
sentences.zh: 因为荷兰国立博物馆与卢浮宫最近共同购买了那对伦勃朗的婚礼肖像画，

sentences.en: there was an opportunity to closely compare Six's young gentleman, especially with the portrait of the bridegroom, Martin Sulmans.
sentences.zh: 因此有机会将西克斯的那幅年轻绅士肖像画进行仔细比对，尤其是与新郎马丁·苏尔曼斯的肖像画进行对比。

sentences.en: Those tests showed, as Six asserted in a 2018 book he wrote about the painting, that the two paintings were made with exactly the same materials, follow the same
sentences.zh: 正如西克斯在2018年撰写的关于这幅画的书中所断言的那样，这些测试表明，这两幅画使用了完全相同的材料，遵循相同的

sentences.en: build-up in paint layers, follow the same working method of painting from back to front, and, most
sentences.zh: 油漆层堆叠方式，遵循从后往前的绘画工作方法，而且最

sentences.en: importantly, both have the unique black-on-white method that was used to paint the lace collars.
sentences.zh: 重要的是，两者都采用了独特的“白底黑”方法来绘制蕾丝领子。

sentences.en: In other words, he was saying his painting was just as much a Rembrandt as the one that cost tens of millions of dollars.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，他是在说他的画和那幅价值数千万美元的画一样，都是伦勃朗的真迹。

sentences.en: Museums, however, try to avoid being used by dealers as marketing tools, and Noble was not willing to be so declarative.
sentences.zh: 然而，博物馆尽量避免被艺术商当作营销工具，诺布尔也不愿做出如此明确的表态。

sentences.en: We have to be very careful about coming out with a conclusion, she said.
sentences.zh: 她说，我们在得出结论时必须非常谨慎。

sentences.en: There are a lot of similarities and still a lot of questions that require more research.
sentences.zh: 有很多相似之处，但仍有许多问题需要进一步研究。

sentences.en: Six next lined up prominent scholars to support his attribution of the painting to Rembrandt.
sentences.zh: 西克斯随后邀请了知名学者来支持他将这幅画归为伦勃朗作品的观点。

sentences.en: It's worth noting that some were unwilling to do so, not because they definitively believed otherwise, but as part of a shift toward acknowledging the gray areas in art history.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，有些人并不愿意这样做，这并不是因为他们确信事实并非如此，而是因为艺术界正转向承认艺术史中的灰色地带。

sentences.en: For such a painting, which seemingly came out of nowhere, there is no way to achieve absolute certainty about its provenance.
sentences.zh: 对于这样一幅似乎凭空出现的画作，不可能对其来源达成绝对的确定性。

sentences.en: When Jan came to me with his painting, I had to admit I couldn't contest his arguments,
sentences.zh: 当扬带着他的画来找我时，我不得不承认我无法反驳他的论点，

sentences.en: said Gary Schwartz, an American Rembrandt biographer and an authority on 17th century Dutch art.
sentences.zh: 美国伦勃朗传记作家、17世纪荷兰艺术权威加里·施瓦茨说。

sentences.en: And I told him I wouldn't express doubts about Rembrandt's authorship, but it doesn't make me happy to be so definitive.
sentences.zh: 我告诉他，我不会对伦勃朗的作者身份表示怀疑，但要我下如此定论，我也并不感到高兴。

sentences.en: He went on to elaborate the particular difficulties that Rembrandt poses for authenticators.
sentences.zh: 他接着阐述了伦勃朗作品在鉴定方面所带来的特殊困难。

sentences.en: The variety of styles he painted in, his many pupils, the likelihood that in his studio more than one person worked on a given painting.
sentences.zh: 他绘画风格的多样性、他的众多学生，以及在工作室里不止一人参与创作的可能性。

sentences.en: A painting that is determined to be, say, by the studio of Rembrandt, rather than by Rembrandt himself, would be of lesser value.
sentences.zh: 如果一幅画被认定是“伦勃朗工作室”的作品，而不是伦勃朗本人的作品，其价值就会降低。

sentences.en: Schwartz is one of a number of art historians who, when it comes to questions of the authenticity of works by famous painters,
sentences.zh: 施瓦茨是众多艺术史学家之一，在涉及著名画家作品的真伪问题时，

sentences.en: would like people to focus less on the artist and the monetary worth of the painting than on the work itself.
sentences.zh: 他希望人们少关注艺术家和画作的货币价值，而多关注作品本身。

sentences.en: He uses the term Rembrandt-ness and argues for assigning shades of likelihood that a painting is by the artist himself.
sentences.zh: 他使用了“伦勃朗特质”一词，并主张为一幅画出自艺术家本人之手的可能性划分等级。

sentences.en: Regarding the Rembrandt-ness of this particular portrait, he said, the attribution to Rembrandt is the hypothesis to beat, but it may not be unbeatable.
sentences.zh: 关于这幅特定肖像画的“伦勃朗特质”，他说，归为伦勃朗作品是目前最有力的假设，但它可能并非无懈可击。

sentences.en: Museums try to respect Rembrandt-ness.
sentences.zh: 博物馆试图尊重“伦勃朗特质”。

sentences.en: The National Gallery of Art in London, for example, labels an old man in an armchair as probably by Rembrandt, and the Moritzhaus Museum recently
sentences.zh: 例如，伦敦国家美术馆将一幅《扶手椅上的老人》标注为“可能是伦勃朗所作”，而莫瑞泰斯皇家美术馆最近

sentences.en: announced that it is mounting an exhaustive study of two of its supposed Rembrandts to try to determine the likelihood of their being by the master.
sentences.zh: 宣布，正在对其两幅所谓的伦勃朗作品进行详尽研究，以确定它们出自大师之手的可能性。

sentences.en: I think Rembrandt-ness is a smart idea, said Ronnie
sentences.zh: 我认为“伦勃朗特质”是一个聪明的想法，波士顿美术馆欧洲绘画高级策展人罗尼·贝尔说，

sentences.en: Bear, senior curator of European paintings at the Museum of Fine Arts in Boston, but people aren't going
sentences.zh: 但人们不会满足于此，因为鉴定涉及太多的金钱利益。

sentences.en: to be content with it because there's so much money involved in attribution.
sentences.zh: 关于这幅画是否出自伦勃朗之手，最重要的意见来自范·德·韦特林。

sentences.en: The most important opinion on whether or not the painting was by Rembrandt was that of von der Wettering.
sentences.zh: 这位伦勃朗学者在画作分析期间保留了判断。

sentences.en: The Rembrandt scholar withheld judgment while the painting was being analyzed.
sentences.zh: 范·德·韦特林告诉我，随着修复工作的进行，我越来越确信了。

sentences.en: As the restoration was being done, I was more and more convinced, von der Wettering told me.
sentences.zh: 我认为扬·西克斯的评估是正确的。

sentences.en: I thought that Jan Sixx was right in his assessment.
sentences.zh: 然而，最终他补充了一个重要的警告。

sentences.en: Eventually, however, he added an important caveat.
sentences.zh: 他现在认为西克斯的画最初是一幅更大作品的一部分。

sentences.en: He now believes Sixx's painting was originally part of a larger work.
sentences.zh: 一个线索是画中人物的面部略显模糊。

sentences.en: One tip-off was the fact that the face is slightly blurred.
sentences.zh: 范·德·韦特林告诉我，伦勃朗在群像画中会这样做，目的是引导观众的视线看向构图中的中心人物。

sentences.en: Rembrandt does this in group portraits, von der Wettering told me, in order to guide the eye to the central figure in the composition.
sentences.zh: 他说，另一个人一定是在稍微靠前的位置。

sentences.en: The other figure must have been slightly to the foreground, he said.
sentences.zh: 那可能是一个女性形象，原画可能是一幅后来被切割开的婚礼肖像画。

sentences.en: It may have been a female figure, and the original painting was possibly a wedding portrait that was later cut apart.
sentences.zh: 在后来接受荷兰报纸采访时，范·德·韦特林断言，如果正如他所想，这只是更大作品的碎片，那将降低其重要性。

sentences.en: In a later interview with the Dutch newspaper, von der Wettering asserted that if it were, as he thought, a fragment of a much larger work, that would diminish its importance.
sentences.zh: 2016年，在扬·西克斯在佳士得目录中看到那幅年轻绅士肖像画的第二天，他遇到了一位名叫罗尼·帕拉什的女士。

sentences.en: The day after Jan Sixx encountered the portrait of the young gentleman in the Christie's catalogue, back in 2016, he met a woman named Ronny Palash.
sentences.zh: 当时他刚经历了一场艰难的离婚。

sentences.en: He was coming off a difficult divorce.
sentences.zh: 两人几乎一见钟情。

sentences.en: The two hit it off almost immediately.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我的第一件事就是：我想我发现了一幅伦勃朗，

sentences.en: One of the first things he told me was, I think I've discovered a Rembrandt,
sentences.zh: 帕拉什去年七月告诉我。

sentences.en: Palash told me last July.
sentences.zh: 当我们开始约会时，他一直在谈论这件事。

sentences.en: As we began dating, he talked about it all the time.
sentences.zh: 帕拉什是一家荷兰出版社的编辑和公关人员。

sentences.en: Palash was an editor and publicist for a Dutch publishing house.
sentences.zh: 她说，西克斯告诉她，他计划写一篇学术论文来配合揭幕，而当她看他的笔记时，觉得很无聊。

sentences.en: She said that Sixx told her he was planning to write a scholarly treatise to accompany the unveiling, and that when she looked at his notes, she found them boring.
sentences.zh: 她开始酝酿一个想法。

sentences.en: She started to hatch an idea.
sentences.zh: 他是一个家族的后裔，这个家族在荷兰以与伟大艺术、特别是与伦勃朗的联系而闻名，而现在他自己发现了一幅伦勃朗。

sentences.en: Here was the scion of a family that is famous in the Netherlands for its connection to great art, and to Rembrandt in particular, and now he had discovered a Rembrandt on his own.
sentences.zh: 作为一名公关人员，我从商业角度看待这件事，她说。

sentences.en: As a publicist, I looked at this in a commercial way, she said.
sentences.zh: 她的想法是以推出重磅书籍的方式来揭幕这幅画，进行全方位的媒体轰炸。

sentences.en: Her idea was to unveil the painting in the same way a blockbuster book would be introduced, with a full media blitz.
sentences.zh: 西克斯起初很抗拒。他说，这没有太大的公众市场。

sentences.en: Sixx resisted at firSt. I said there's not a big public for this, he said.
sentences.zh: 古典大师的作品通常是给有闲暇时间的老年人看的。

sentences.en: The old masters are usually for senior citizens who have free time.
sentences.zh: 帕拉什坚持己见，最终他听从了她的建议。

sentences.en: Palash pushed back, and eventually he followed her lead.
sentences.zh: 我一直在说服扬，这个故事将会产生多大的影响，她说。

sentences.en: I was constantly convincing Jan of how big this story was going to be, she said.
sentences.zh: 2018年5月，在西克斯第一次在伦敦看到这幅画近一年半后，他出现在荷兰最受欢迎的脱口秀节目之一《Pauw》上。

sentences.en: In May 2018, nearly a year and a half after Sixx first saw the picture in London, he appeared live on Pau, one of the most popular talk shows in the Netherlands.
sentences.zh: 经过简短的介绍，节目主持人和西克斯一起拉开了画布上的黑布，引来观众的一阵欢呼。

sentences.en: After a brief introduction, the show's host, together with Sixx, pulled a black cloth off the canvas to the whoops of the audience.
sentences.zh: 这次电视亮相是媒体宣传活动的中心，其中还包括全国顶级报纸《NRC商报》的独家头版报道，

sentences.en: The TV appearance was the centerpiece of the media campaign, which also included an exclusive front-page story in the nation's top newspaper,
sentences.zh: 以及西克斯撰写的关于这幅画的精美书籍《伦勃朗的年轻绅士肖像》。

sentences.en: an Arce Handelsblatt, and a slickly produced book, Rembrandt's Portrait of a Young Gentleman, that Sixx wrote about the painting.
sentences.zh: 接下来的几天里，这个消息传遍了全世界。

sentences.en: Over the next few days, the news echoed around the world.
sentences.zh: 这本书立即成为荷兰的畅销书，英文版和法文版也已付印。

sentences.en: The book became an instant bestseller in Dutch, and English and French editions went to press.
sentences.zh: 荷兰人喜欢指出他们是一个极其平等且直言不讳的群体。

sentences.en: Dutch people like to point out that they are an aggressively egalitarian and plain-spoken lot.
sentences.zh: 他们的语言中有几句关于傲慢危险的谚语。

sentences.en: There are several sayings in the language about the danger of hubris.
sentences.zh: 树大招风。

sentences.en: The tallest tree takes the most wind.
sentences.zh: 出头鸟容易被枪打。

sentences.en: Stick your head out too far, and it will get chopped off.
sentences.zh: 古典大师的世界也倾向于追求谨慎，即使不是谦逊，也胜过炫耀。

sentences.en: The old master's world, too, tends to prefer discretion, if not modesty, to showiness.
sentences.zh: 西克斯宣布他发现作品时的那种张扬，挑战了这两种文化。

sentences.en: The flamboyance with which Sixx announced his find defied both cultures.
sentences.zh: 然而，传统艺术的守门人非但没有对这种张扬嗤之以鼻，反而最初被该领域获得的额外关注所震撼。

sentences.en: Yet the gatekeepers of traditional art, far from turning up their noses at the showiness, were initially wowed by the extra attention the field was getting.
sentences.zh: 荷兰国立博物馆前馆长维姆·皮布斯当时向我形容这次电视揭幕是一个“非常成功推出的企业，相当令人惊叹”。

sentences.en: Vim Pibus, former director of the Rijksmuseum, characterized the TV unveiling to me at the time as a very well-launched enterprise and quite amazing.
sentences.zh: 当大众热情的浪潮席卷西克斯时，我问他，如果他离开苏富比是因为

sentences.en: As the wave of popular enthusiasm was washing over Sixx, I asked him why, if his departure from Sotheby's had been motivated by
sentences.zh: 厌恶艺术商品化，为什么现在又参与其中。

sentences.en: a distaste for the commodification of art, he was now participating in it.
sentences.zh: 他耸了耸肩，做了一句简短的忏悔。

sentences.en: He shrugged and gave a one-line mea culpa.
sentences.zh: 我是个商人。

sentences.en: I'm a businessman.
sentences.zh: 但后来他给出了一个更具反思性的回答。

sentences.en: But later he offered a more introspective response.
sentences.zh: 多年来，我一直在心里挣扎，想证明我凭自己的能力了解绘画。

sentences.en: For years I've been struggling in my mind to prove that I know something about paintings in my own right.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴到目前为止，从美国到中国的所有文章中，他们写的是作为艺术商的我，而不是作为西克斯家族成员的我。

sentences.en: I'm happy that what they're writing in all the articles so far, from America to China, is about me as a dealer, not as a Sixx.
sentences.zh: 2018年9月，在西克斯电视亮相四个月后，距离佳士得拍卖近两年，一位名叫桑德·巴约的荷兰艺术商，

sentences.en: In September 2018, four months after Sixx made his televised splash, and nearly two years after the Christie's sale, a Dutch art dealer named Sander
sentences.zh: 来自阿姆斯特丹以北的阿尔克马尔市，对《NRC商报》的一名记者声称，

sentences.en: Bayeux from Alkmaar, a city north of Amsterdam, spoke to a reporter from NRC Handelsblatt, and claimed that,
sentences.zh: 事实上，他也认出了目录中的那幅画很可能是伦勃朗的作品。

sentences.en: in fact, he too had recognized the catalog image as most likely being a Rembrandt.
sentences.zh: 巴约接着声称，他曾就共同购买这幅画与西克斯接触，

sentences.en: Bayeux went on to claim that he had approached Sixx about buying the painting together,
sentences.zh: 西克斯同意了，两人还承诺将联合出价上限控制在10万欧元出头，这是巴约所能承受的最高价。

sentences.en: that Sixx agreed, and that the two men further committed to cap their joint bid just above 100,000 euros, which was as high as Bayeux was able to go.
sentences.zh: 当这幅画以15.3万欧元成交时，

sentences.en: When the painting sold for 153,000 euros,
sentences.zh: 巴约说，他从未想到中标者竟然是西克斯。

sentences.en: Bayeux said, it never occurred to him that the winning bidder was Sixx.
sentences.zh: 巴约指责西克斯与他达成协议，然后又通过中间人单独出价更高，

sentences.en: Bayeux was accusing Sixx of entering an agreement with him, then separately putting in another higher bid of his own through
sentences.zh: 目的是为了压制一个看到了作品真实价值的竞争对手。

sentences.en: an intermediary, in order to hem in a competitor who saw the true value of the work.
sentences.zh: 正如另一位古典大师艺术商告诉我的那样，这在我们的行业里是不被允许的。

sentences.en: As another old master's dealer told me, that's not done in our business.
sentences.zh: 巴约在报纸采访中声称，荷兰古典大师界的宠儿扬·西克斯是个骗子，这在国际艺术界引起了轰动。

sentences.en: Bayeux's newspaper interview claiming that Jan Sixx, the darling of the Dutch old master's world, was a cheat reverberated around the international art community.
sentences.zh: 巴约后来告诉我，他别无选择，只能站出来保护自己的名誉。

sentences.en: Bayeux later told me that he had no choice but to come forward to protect his own reputation.
sentences.zh: 他觉得，如果同行认为他错过了一幅伦勃朗，那对他来说将是非常糟糕的评价。

sentences.en: He felt that it reflected poorly on him among dealers and others in the field if they believed that he'd missed a Rembrandt.
sentences.zh: 他感到愤怒的是，在西克斯电视揭幕肖像画期间以及随后的媒体露面中，西克斯将

sentences.en: He was enraged that during Sixx's televised unveiling of the portrait and in subsequent media appearances, Sixx described
sentences.zh: 寻找、研究和购买它的过程描述为完全个人的事业，其中

sentences.en: the process of finding, researching, and buying it as a strictly solo enterprise, in which he was
sentences.zh: 他只得到了范·德·韦特林的专业知识和匿名支持者的资金帮助。

sentences.en: aided only by the expertise of von der Wettering and the funds of his anonymous backer.
sentences.zh: 他觉得这完全抹杀了他在其中的贡献。

sentences.en: Jan Sixx was going around with his discovery that only he could find, saying, Is everybody else in the business stupid, or am I that smart?
sentences.zh: 扬·西克斯到处宣扬他那只有他自己能发现的“发现”，并说：“难道这行里其他人都是傻瓜，还是说我太聪明了？”

sentences.en: He knew very well that we had both seen it.
sentences.zh: 他非常清楚我们俩都看到了那幅画。

sentences.en: Bayeux forwarded me a chain of WhatsApp messages he had sent to Sixx before the Christie's sale, which included snapshots of parts of the canvas detailing his own study of it.
sentences.zh: 巴约转发给我一连串他在佳士得拍卖会前发给西克斯的 WhatsApp 消息，其中包含了画布局部的快照，详细记录了他自己对这幅画的研究。

sentences.en: They seemed to prove that Bayeux had seen the painting in person before Sixx made it to the Christie's showroom.
sentences.zh: 这些似乎证明了在西克斯到达佳士得展厅之前，巴约就已经亲眼见过这幅画了。

sentences.en: Sixx told me last September that he never agreed to buy the portrait with Bayeux.
sentences.zh: 去年九月，西克斯告诉我，他从未同意与巴约一起购买这幅肖像画。

sentences.en: He did seem to suggest, however, that he had led the other dealer on.
sentences.zh: 然而，他确实暗示过自己曾误导过那位同行。

sentences.en: I was very scared that Sander would alert the auction house that they had something special,
sentences.zh: “我非常担心桑德会提醒拍卖行他们手里有件特别的东西，”

sentences.en: he said, and Christie's would take the picture out of the sale, which has happened to me before.
sentences.zh: 他说，“然后佳士得会把这幅画撤出拍卖，这种事我以前遇到过。”

sentences.en: I said, what do you want to do?
sentences.zh: “我说，你想怎么做？”

sentences.en: Sixx claimed to me that by this he meant, what are you planning to do, but that Bayeux took it as an agreement that they would work together on the picture.
sentences.zh: 西克斯向我声称，他的意思是“你打算怎么做”，但巴约却将其理解为他们将就这幅画展开合作的协议。

sentences.en: Sixx told the newspaper De Volkskrant last October, I gave Sander room to believe in his own story.
sentences.zh: 去年十月，西克斯告诉《人民报》：“我给了桑德空间，让他相信自己的故事。”

sentences.en: The Dutch found the new development especially titillating because of the parallels between the two art dealers.
sentences.zh: 荷兰人觉得这一新进展特别引人入胜，因为这两位艺术品商之间有着诸多相似之处。

sentences.en: They are about the same age.
sentences.zh: 他们年龄相仿。

sentences.en: Bayeux's father, Martin Bayeux, is one of the premier art restorers in the Netherlands, whose resume of refurbishing paintings includes many
sentences.zh: 巴约的父亲马丁·巴约是荷兰顶尖的艺术品修复师之一，他的修复作品清单中包括许多

sentences.en: Rembrandts.
sentences.zh: 伦勃朗的作品。

sentences.en: Like Sixx, Sander Bayeux grew up surrounded by old Dutch art.
sentences.zh: 和西克斯一样，桑德·巴约从小就沉浸在荷兰古典艺术的氛围中。

sentences.en: But there was a difference in status between the two men.
sentences.zh: 但两人的地位存在差异。

sentences.en: I'm the kind of dealer who has a booth at all the art fairs,
sentences.zh: “我是那种在所有艺术博览会上都有展位的艺术品商，”

sentences.en: Bayeux told me.
sentences.zh: 巴约告诉我。

sentences.en: Jan Sixx doesn't bother himself with that.
sentences.zh: “扬·西克斯才不屑于做这些。”

sentences.en: I'm little Sander Bayeux from Altmaar.
sentences.zh: “我是来自阿尔克马尔的小人物桑德·巴约。”

sentences.en: He's aristocratic Jan Sixx from Amsterdam.
sentences.zh: “他是来自阿姆斯特丹的贵族扬·西克斯。”

sentences.en: In the wake of Bayeux's accusation, Sixx revealed to me another piece of information that seemed to dwarf the spat between the art dealers.
sentences.zh: 在巴约提出指控后，西克斯向我透露了另一条信息，似乎让这两位艺术品商之间的争执显得微不足道了。

sentences.en: Earlier I asked him about a rumor going around that he had discovered a second Rembrandt.
sentences.zh: 早些时候，我问过他关于他发现了第二幅伦勃朗画作的传闻。

sentences.en: He denied it.
sentences.zh: 他否认了。

sentences.en: Now he said it was true.
sentences.zh: 现在他说那是真的。

sentences.en: Sixx said he had found this other Rembrandt two years before he'd seen the portrait at Christie's,
sentences.zh: 西克斯说，他在佳士得看到那幅肖像画的两年前就发现了这幅伦勃朗作品，

sentences.en: but had agreed not to make the find public until the end of 2019, when it would be a centerpiece of
sentences.zh: 但他同意在 2019 年底之前不对外公开这一发现，届时它将成为

sentences.en: the reopening of the Lock and Hall Museum in Leiden, the city of Rembrandt's birth, in conjunction with the 350th anniversary of the artist's death.
sentences.zh: 莱顿（伦勃朗的出生地）拉克和霍尔博物馆重新开放的核心展品，以纪念这位艺术家逝世 350 周年。

sentences.en: But this accusation from Sander Bayeux, Sixx told me, changed things.
sentences.zh: 但西克斯告诉我，桑德·巴约的这一指控改变了一切。

sentences.en: In order to explain what happened between himself and Bayeux, he said, he needed to go public with the news that he had found a second Rembrandt.
sentences.zh: 他说，为了解释他和巴约之间发生的事情，他必须公开自己发现第二幅伦勃朗画作的消息。

sentences.en: He did so on September 14th, making yet another theatrical unveiling on Powell.
sentences.zh: 他在 9 月 14 日这样做了，又一次在鲍威尔节目上进行了戏剧性的揭幕。

sentences.en: Sixx told me that he first noticed this painting, a biblical scene depicting Jesus surrounded by children and onlookers, in the online catalogue of a German auction house in 2014.
sentences.zh: 西克斯告诉我，他最初是在 2014 年一家德国拍卖行的在线目录中注意到这幅画的，那是一幅描绘耶稣被儿童和旁观者环绕的圣经场景。

sentences.en: All those years of looking at Rembrandt seemed to pay off in a flash.
sentences.zh: 多年来对伦勃朗的研究似乎在瞬间得到了回报。

sentences.en: What caught his eye was what appeared to be a self-portrait of a very young Rembrandt in one of the minor figures.
sentences.zh: 吸引他目光的是其中一个次要人物，看起来像是年轻伦勃朗的自画像。

sentences.en: The detail excited Sixx not only because it so closely resembled other self-portraits of the artist,
sentences.zh: 这个细节让西克斯感到兴奋，不仅因为它与这位艺术家的其他自画像非常相似，

sentences.en: but also because it fit into Rembrandt's early tendency to work his own likeness into his paintings.
sentences.zh: 还因为它符合伦勃朗早期将自己的形象融入画作的倾向。

sentences.en: The painting had a pre-auction estimate of $20,000 to $27,000, but the dealer Otto Naumann had also spotted it as a probable Rembrandt and was determined to buy it.
sentences.zh: 这幅画的拍卖前估价为 2 万至 2.7 万美元，但艺术品商奥托·诺曼也看出它很可能是伦勃朗的作品，并决心买下它。

sentences.en: As a result, Sixx, together with his anonymous investor, ended up paying $2 million.
sentences.zh: 结果，西克斯和他的匿名投资者最终花了 200 万美元。

sentences.en: It is thought to have been painted very early in
sentences.zh: 人们认为这幅画创作于

sentences.en: Rembrandt's career, possibly when he was only 19, and to be his first known work on canvas.
sentences.zh: 伦勃朗职业生涯的早期，可能在他 19 岁时，也是他已知的第一幅布面作品。

sentences.en: The painting was heavily painted over by a later artist, robes redone in different colors, a naked boy covered up.
sentences.zh: 这幅画后来被另一位艺术家大面积覆盖，长袍被改成了不同的颜色，一个裸体男孩也被遮盖了。

sentences.en: To try to return it to something like the state the master intended,
sentences.zh: 为了尝试将其恢复到大师预想的状态，

sentences.en: Sixx decided to have the overpainting removed.
sentences.zh: 西克斯决定清除覆盖层。

sentences.en: Once again he consulted van de Wetering, who, he says, all but insisted that he have Martin Biel do the extremely delicate restoration.
sentences.zh: 他再次咨询了范德韦特林，据他说，范德韦特林几乎坚持要他请马丁·比尔进行极其精细的修复。

sentences.en: I didn't want to do it, but Ernst was quite adamant about it, he told me, seeming to imply that if he wanted the blessing of the Rembrandt scholar,
sentences.zh: “我不想那样做，但恩斯特非常坚持，”他告诉我，似乎暗示如果他想得到这位伦勃朗学者的祝福，

sentences.en: he had to work with the father of Sander Biel.
sentences.zh: 他就必须与桑德·比尔的父亲合作。

sentences.en: Sixx said that he made a deal with Martin Biel to restore the painting and that it was while that painstaking work was being done that Sixx discovered
sentences.zh: 西克斯说，他与马丁·比尔达成了修复画作的协议，正是在进行那项艰苦工作时，西克斯发现了

sentences.en: the portrait in the Christie's catalog and showed it to van de Wetering.
sentences.zh: 佳士得目录中的那幅肖像画，并将其展示给了范德韦特林。

sentences.en: Not long after, Sander Biel, the son of the restorer, sent Sixx a WhatsApp message.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，修复师的儿子桑德·比尔给西克斯发了一条 WhatsApp 消息。

sentences.en: Jan, I understand that you've talked with
sentences.zh: “扬，我听说你和

sentences.en: Martin and Ernst about the portrait that's about to be auctioned.
sentences.zh: 马丁以及恩斯特谈过那幅即将拍卖的肖像画了。”

sentences.en: But Sixx had not talked to Martin Biel about the portrait.
sentences.zh: 但西克斯并没有和马丁·比尔谈过那幅肖像画。

sentences.en: He said it was clear to him from this message that van de Wetering had violated his confidence by informing Martin Biel that Sixx was on the hunt for another Rembrandt and that the
sentences.zh: 他说，从这条消息中他很清楚，范德韦特林泄露了他的秘密，告诉马丁·比尔西克斯正在寻找另一幅伦勃朗作品，而且

sentences.en: father had told his son.
sentences.zh: 父亲把这件事告诉了儿子。

sentences.en: He repeated this assertion on Pau in September 2018, as well as the assertion that van de Wetering pushed him to use Martin Biel.
sentences.zh: 他在 2018 年 9 月的《保罗》节目中重复了这一说法，同时也重申了范德韦特林强迫他使用马丁·比尔的说法。

sentences.en: Suddenly, Sander was trying to get friendly with me,
sentences.zh: “突然间，桑德开始试图和我套近乎，”

sentences.en: Sixx told me, and making overtures about the two of them buying the portrait together.
sentences.zh: 西克斯告诉我，“并提出要两人一起买下这幅肖像画。”

sentences.en: Meanwhile, he said Martin Biel was demanding more money to complete the restoration of the first painting.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，他说马丁·比尔要求更多的钱来完成第一幅画的修复工作。

sentences.en: Not just an hourly fee, as per the original agreement, but a percentage of profits from the sale of the painting.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是按照最初协议的每小时费用，而是要从画作销售利润中分成。

sentences.en: It was a form of blackmail, Sixx said.
sentences.zh: 西克斯说，这是一种勒索。

sentences.en: I emailed Martin Biel for his response to this charge.
sentences.zh: 我给马丁·比尔发了电子邮件，询问他对这一指控的回应。

sentences.en: He did not reply, but his son did, saying that his father asked for more money after Sixx demanded
sentences.zh: 他没有回复，但他的儿子回复了，说他父亲是在西克斯要求

sentences.en: that he speed up his restoration work, which would have required him to turn down other clients.
sentences.zh: 他加快修复工作后才要求加钱的，因为这需要他拒绝其他客户。

sentences.en: He sent me a chain of WhatsApp messages between Sixx and the elder Biel that suggested a cordial relationship.
sentences.zh: 他发给我一连串西克斯和老比尔之间的 WhatsApp 消息，显示出他们关系融洽。

sentences.en: Sander Biel did not deny that he learned about Sixx's interest in the painting through his father, who in fact heard about it from van de Wetering.
sentences.zh: 桑德·比尔并不否认他是通过父亲得知西克斯对这幅画感兴趣的，而他父亲实际上是从范德韦特林那里听说的。

sentences.en: But he said that such interactions are normal and inevitable within the small world of Dutch old masters.
sentences.zh: 但他表示，在荷兰古典大师的小圈子里，这种互动是正常且不可避免的。

sentences.en: But he says that by the time his father told him of Sixx's interest in the portrait, he had already realized that Christie's was selling a
sentences.zh: 但他表示，当他父亲告诉他西克斯对这幅肖像画感兴趣时，他已经意识到佳士得正在将一幅

sentences.en: possible Rembrandt portrait as the work of a minor painter.
sentences.zh: 可能的伦勃朗肖像画作为次要画家的作品进行拍卖。

sentences.en: He forwarded me an email he sent to Christie's in November 2016, requesting a high-resolution photo of the painting, which was dated days before Sixx
sentences.zh: 他转发给我一封他在 2016 年 11 月发给佳士得的电子邮件，要求提供该画的高清照片，日期比西克斯

sentences.en: himself told me he first saw it, indicating, in other words, that he had taken note of the picture on his own.
sentences.zh: 本人告诉我他第一次看到它的时间还要早几天，换句话说，这表明他自己已经注意到了这幅画。

sentences.en: He said that he and Sixx had done business together on occasion.
sentences.zh: 他说他和西克斯偶尔会做生意。

sentences.en: He bought a couple of small works from Sixx early last year, he said.
sentences.zh: 他说，去年年初他从西克斯那里买了几件小作品。

sentences.en: So it was normal for him to approach Sixx with the idea of buying the painting together.
sentences.zh: 所以他带着一起买下这幅画的想法去接触西克斯是很正常的。

sentences.en: When I talked to Sander Biel by phone this past December, after his dispute with Sixx had been batted around in the Dutch media for a couple of months, he suggested that
sentences.zh: 去年十二月，当我和桑德·比尔通电话时，在他们与西克斯的纠纷在荷兰媒体上发酵了几个月后，他暗示

sentences.en: Sixx's effort to erase Biel's involvement in the painting's purchase came out of Sixx's struggle with his inner demons.
sentences.zh: 西克斯试图抹去比尔在购买这幅画过程中的参与，是源于西克斯与内心魔鬼的斗争。

sentences.en: He has a problem with the burden of the Sixx name, and he feels he needs to prove himself.
sentences.zh: “他背负着西克斯这个姓氏的重担，他觉得需要证明自己。”

sentences.en: I have to pay for his personal family issues?
sentences.zh: “我得为他个人的家庭问题买单吗？”

sentences.en: No, he cheated me.
sentences.zh: “不，他欺骗了我。”

sentences.en: Along with headlines like
sentences.zh: 伴随着诸如

sentences.en: Rembrandt Discoverer Jan Sixx Accused of Deception, came another unpleasant surprise for Sixx.
sentences.zh: “伦勃朗发现者扬·西克斯被指控欺诈”之类的头条新闻，西克斯又迎来了一个令人不快的意外。

sentences.en: Von De Wettering, whom Sixx had spent his professional life in awe of, gave a blistering public response
sentences.zh: 西克斯职业生涯一直敬畏的范德韦特林，对西克斯的断言做出了猛烈的公开回应，

sentences.en: to Sixx's assertions that he had forced Sixx to use Martin Biel and that he had violated a confidence.
sentences.zh: 即他强迫西克斯使用马丁·比尔以及他泄露了秘密。

sentences.en: While just weeks before, Von De Wettering had told me that he and Sixx had a great kinship, in the wake of Sixx's accusation, he told NRC Handelsblad,
sentences.zh: 就在几周前，范德韦特林还告诉我他和西克斯有着深厚的亲情，但在西克斯提出指控后，他告诉《NRC商报》：

sentences.en: Sixx has shown his true nature.
sentences.zh: “西克斯露出了他的真面目。”

sentences.en: I now know that he can lie.
sentences.zh: “我现在知道他会撒谎。”

sentences.en: He declared their friendship at an end.
sentences.zh: 他宣布他们的友谊到此为止。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, in the same interview, Von De Wettering gave a glowing assessment of Sixx's other discovery.
sentences.zh: 然而，在同一次采访中，范德韦特林对西克斯的另一个发现给予了高度评价。

sentences.en: The biblical painting, he said, was a great find that shows a phase in the development of the young Rembrandt.
sentences.zh: 他说，那幅圣经题材的画作是一个伟大的发现，展示了年轻伦勃朗发展的一个阶段。

sentences.en: When Sixx and I met again in October, he was in a defiant mood.
sentences.zh: 十月我和西克斯再次见面时，他情绪激昂。

sentences.en: He has long, dark hair that, when he is exasperated, tends to fall across his face like a curtain.
sentences.zh: 他留着深色的长发，当他恼火时，头发往往会像帘子一样垂在脸上。

sentences.en: He raked it back in place with one hand as he made his case.
sentences.zh: 他在陈述自己的观点时，用一只手把头发向后捋了捋。

sentences.en: He insisted that Sander Biel was just trying to cash in on Sixx's own success.
sentences.zh: 他坚持认为桑德·比尔只是想利用西克斯自己的成功来获利。

sentences.en: When Dan Brown wrote The Da Vinci Code, he had all kinds of lawsuits, he said.
sentences.zh: 他说：“当丹·布朗写《达芬奇密码》时，他遇到了各种各样的诉讼。”

sentences.en: Frankly, I think I'm lucky I only have one guy coming after me.
sentences.zh: “坦白说，我觉得我很幸运，只有一个家伙来找我麻烦。”

sentences.en: He waved away my suggestion that his fixation on Rembrandt had clouded his professional judgment.
sentences.zh: 他挥手拒绝了我的建议，即他对伦勃朗的执着影响了他的专业判断。

sentences.en: He wouldn't even credit the seemingly straightforward evidence that Biel had spotted the portrait as a likely Rembrandt on his own.
sentences.zh: 他甚至不愿相信比尔凭自己就认出这幅肖像画很可能是伦勃朗作品这一看似直接的证据。

sentences.en: And he expressed bitterness that a plot by others, motivated, he said, by jealousy and greed, had marred what was to be his personal and professional breakthrough
sentences.zh: 他表达了痛苦，认为他人的阴谋——他说是由嫉妒和贪婪驱动的——破坏了他本应是个人和职业生涯的突破，

sentences.en: and obscured an unprecedented achievement.
sentences.zh: 并掩盖了一项前所未有的成就。

sentences.en: In the history of mankind, nobody before has ever discovered two Rembrandts.
sentences.zh: “在人类历史上，此前从未有人发现过两幅伦勃朗作品。”

sentences.en: Despite its decline in the market and in university syllabuses,
sentences.zh: 尽管在市场和大学课程中有所衰落，

sentences.en: Dutch old masters' art continues to have great popular appeal.
sentences.zh: 荷兰古典大师的艺术仍然具有巨大的大众吸引力。

sentences.en: The success over the years of the book and film Girl with the Pearl Earring and Donna Tartt's novel The Goldfinch, which has a painting by
sentences.zh: 多年来，书籍和电影《戴珍珠耳环的少女》以及唐娜·塔特的《金翅雀》的成功——该书以十七世纪荷兰艺术家卡尔·法布里蒂乌斯的一幅画为中心，

sentences.en: the seventeenth-century Dutch artist Carl Fabrizius at its center and is now being made into a movie, are mirrored in visitor attendance at museum exhibitions.
sentences.zh: 目前正在被改编成电影——在博物馆展览的参观人数中得到了反映。

sentences.en: Since the Rijksmuseum and the Moritzhaus reopened after renovations a few years ago, each institution has seen visitor numbers roughly double.
sentences.zh: 自从几年前国立博物馆和莫瑞泰斯皇家美术馆翻新重新开放以来，每个机构的参观人数都大约翻了一番。

sentences.en: Within old masters I think Dutch art is so much more approachable than, say, Italian religious
sentences.zh: “在古典大师中，我认为荷兰艺术比意大利宗教艺术或夸张的巴洛克艺术要平易近人得多，”

sentences.en: art or overblown Baroque, said Ronnie Bear, curator at the Museum of Fine Arts, by way of explaining its popularity.
sentences.zh: 美术博物馆策展人罗尼·贝尔在解释其受欢迎程度时说道。

sentences.en: Everyone can understand a still life or an interior.
sentences.zh: “每个人都能看懂静物画或室内画。”

sentences.en: If some in the Dutch old masters' world, who know how popular the art is among ordinary people and are hoping to reverse its decline in
sentences.zh: 如果荷兰古典大师界的一些人——他们知道这种艺术在普通民众中有多受欢迎，并希望扭转其在学术界和市场上的衰落——在扬·西克斯做出发现时为他欢呼，

sentences.en: academia and the marketplace, cheered on Jan Six when he made his discoveries, it was surely because they saw him as an appealing young champion of the cause.
sentences.zh: 那肯定是因为他们把他看作是这项事业中一个有吸引力的年轻拥护者。

sentences.en: He has the pedigree, of course, but beyond that he so thoroughly grasps what makes this art special.
sentences.zh: 他当然有家世背景，但除此之外，他非常透彻地理解是什么让这种艺术变得特别。

sentences.en: By turning away from strictly religious subjects and highlighting the world around them, still lives, landscapes, pictures of one another,
sentences.zh: 通过背离严格的宗教主题并突出他们周围的世界——静物、风景、彼此的肖像——当时的画家创作出的艺术作品成为了了解我们是谁的窗口。

sentences.en: the painters of the time created works of art that are windows into who we are.
sentences.zh: 致力于这一领域的人们是出于一种奉献精神，并将其视为一项事业。

sentences.en: People who devote their lives to the field do so out of a sense of dedication and treat it like a cause.
sentences.zh: “我们必须为荷兰艺术的重要性而战，”莫瑞泰斯皇家美术馆（维米尔的《戴珍珠耳环的少女》和法布里蒂乌斯的《金翅雀》的所在地）馆长艾米丽·戈登克尔说。

sentences.en: We have to fight for the importance of Dutch art, said Emily Gordenker, director of Moritzhaus, the home of Vermeer's Girl with the Pearl Earring, and Fabritius' The Goldfinch.
sentences.zh: “我们必须确保这些画作的故事依然重要。”

sentences.en: We have to make sure the stories of these paintings still matter.
sentences.zh: 该领域的一些顶尖人物，包括博物馆馆长、策展人、学者，在西克斯的惨败后表达了失望，尽管没有人愿意公开讨论此事。

sentences.en: Some of the top people in the field, museum directors, curators, academics, expressed disappointment in Six after his debacle, though none wanted to go on the record discussing it.
sentences.zh: “这是一件非常可悲的事情，因为人们本来就怀疑艺术品商是滑头，”其中一人说。

sentences.en: This is a very sad thing, because people already suspect art dealers of being slippery, one said.
sentences.zh: “我可以告诉你，有些人谈论扬·西克斯就像谈论伊卡洛斯一样。”

sentences.en: I can tell you some people are talking about Jan Six like Icarus.
sentences.zh: 一位艺术品商说，西克斯在处理这场争议时犯了年轻人的错误。

sentences.en: One dealer said that Six had made a young man's mistake in dealing with the controversy.
sentences.zh: 他本应立即采取行动，悄悄解决此事。

sentences.en: He should have acted immediately to settle the matter quietly.
sentences.zh: 这位艺术品商建议，即使他觉得自己在理，为了维护声誉，明智的做法也是达成和解。

sentences.en: Even if he felt he was in the right, the dealer suggested, the prudent move would have been to reach a settlement in the name of preserving your reputation.
sentences.zh: “这行完全建立在信任之上，”这位艺术品商继续说道。

sentences.en: This business is entirely based on trust, the dealer went on.
sentences.zh: “人们必须信任你和你的画。”

sentences.en: People have to trust you and your painting.
sentences.zh: 为了强调这一点，这位艺术品商告诉我，他自己曾问过一位显赫的买家，是否想让他为西克斯发掘的两幅画中的一幅报价，

sentences.en: To underscore the point, the dealer told me that he himself had asked a prominent buyer whether the buyer wanted him to get a price on one of the two paintings Six had unearthed,
sentences.zh: 但买家回答说：“不，别碰那件有争议的作品。”

sentences.en: but that the buyer had responded, not with that controversy around it.
sentences.zh: 不过，在更广阔的世界里，争议终会消散。

sentences.en: In the broader world, though, controversies fade.
sentences.zh: 二月份我最后一次与扬·西克斯交谈时，他的心情完全不同了。

sentences.en: The last time I spoke with Jan Six in February, he was in an altogether different mood.
sentences.zh: 为了纪念今年伦勃朗逝世 350 周年，荷兰广播公司 NPO 请他录制了一部五集电视系列片，西克斯在片中漫步

sentences.en: To commemorate the 350th anniversary of Rembrandt's death this year, the Dutch broadcaster NPO asked him to record a five-part TV series in which Six wanders
sentences.zh: 穿过画家居住的街道，停在莱顿他上学的建筑前，并在各种杰作前沉思。

sentences.en: through streets where the painter lived, stops in front of the building in Leiden where he went to school, and muses before various masterpieces.
sentences.zh: 这是西克斯在做他最擅长的事情，传达他的热情，这一次是面对一个对他来说全新的、非常广泛的观众群体。

sentences.en: It's Six doing what he does best, communicating his passion, this time to a very broad audience which is new for him.
sentences.zh: “有成千上万的人在电视上看着我，并乐在其中，”他说。

sentences.en: There are hundreds of thousands of people watching me on the telly and enjoying it, he said.
sentences.zh: “突然间，各种各样的人都在联系我。”

sentences.en: Suddenly all kinds of people are contacting me.
sentences.zh: “有些人有一幅旧画想让我看看。”

sentences.en: Some have an old painting they want me to look at.
sentences.zh: “刚才有个女人给我打电话。”

sentences.en: A woman just called me.
sentences.zh: “她说她快 75 岁了，她的双胞胎姐妹对伦勃朗着了迷。”

sentences.en: She said she's turning 75 and her twin sister is crazy about Rembrandt.
sentences.zh: “她问我能不能顺便去参加她们的生日午餐，谈十分钟伦勃朗。”

sentences.en: She asked if there was some way I would stop in at their birthday lunch and talk about Rembrandt for ten minutes.
sentences.zh: “太贴心了。”

sentences.en: So sweet.
sentences.zh: “我当然会去。”

sentences.en: Of course I'll go.
sentences.zh: 这给了我很大的鼓舞。这也让他与他所称的“艺术精英泡沫”保持了一定距离，

sentences.en: This has given me a great booSt. It has also given him some distance from the bubble, as he referred
sentences.zh: 并使他能够开始从那激动人心又痛苦不堪的一年中走出来。

sentences.en: to the art elite, and allowed him to begin to move on from his thrilling and excruciating year.
sentences.zh: “那段经历史诗般且美妙，”他说，“然后一切都变了。”

sentences.en: It was epic and fantastic, he said, and then everything changed.
sentences.zh: “我意识到对一位画家如此痴迷并不一定是件好事，但当然，我依然痴迷。”

sentences.en: I realized that being so obsessed with a painter is not necessarily a good thing, but of course I still am.
sentences.zh: 如果你碰巧在阿姆斯特丹市中心漫步，有一个地方可以让你与扬·西克斯——我是指最初的那个扬·西克斯——进行眼神交流。

sentences.en: If you happen to be strolling in central Amsterdam, there is one spot from which it is just possible to make eye contact with Jan Six, the original Jan Six, that is.
sentences.zh: 他的肖像画位于西克斯宅邸中，

sentences.en: His portrait is situated in the Sixth
sentences.zh: 位置巧妙，稍微伸长脖子就能从前面的人行道上看到。

sentences.en: Mansion in such a way that with a little craning, it's visible from the sidewalk in front.
sentences.zh: 他在楼上一层的一个房间里，向下俯视着你。

sentences.en: He's in a room one flight up looking down toward you.
sentences.zh: 第十一代扬喜欢谈论伦勃朗处理眼神的方式。

sentences.en: Jan the Eleventh likes to talk about Rembrandt's way with gazes.
sentences.zh: 这幅他祖先兼同名者的肖像，似乎陷入了一种忧郁的漩涡中，一种对人类生活的挫折和局限性的清醒而疲惫的意识。

sentences.en: This one, of his ancestor and namesake, seems caught in a swirl of melancholy, a knowing, weary consciousness of the frustrations and limitations of human life.
sentences.zh: 那就是第十一代扬·西克斯在青少年时期看着他祖先的肖像时产生的顿悟，这开启了

sentences.en: That was the epiphany that Jan Sixth the Eleventh had as a teenager, looking at the portrait of his ancestor, which set
sentences.zh: 一切。

sentences.en: him off in search of his own identity, distinct from that of his forebears.
sentences.zh: 让他踏上了寻找自我身份的旅程，与他的先辈们截然不同。

sentences.en: That someone from three and a half centuries ago could, with paint on canvas, convey the human essence in a way that is utterly intelligible today.
sentences.zh: 一个三个半世纪前的人，竟能用画布上的颜料，以一种在今天依然完全能够被理解的方式，传达出人类的本质。

sentences.en: That therefore, perhaps, identity, with all its flaws and insecurities, its jets of insight and pools of empathy, as individual as it is, is at the same time universal.
sentences.zh: 因此，或许身份本身，连同它所有的缺陷与不安，它那迸发的洞察力与汇聚的同理心，尽管是个体化的，却同时也是普世的。

sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台严密控制的机器一样运作，直到今年夏天，选举迎来了一批自称改革派的人士。
